Pädagoge

Stellenbeschreibung:
Pädagogische Fachkraft / Erzieher (gn) Wohngruppe – Landkreis Lindau (Bodensee)

Die Sonne scheint, der Himmel ist blau und Sie fragen sich: Gibt's im Landkreis Lindau einen Ort, an dem Pädagogik noch atmen kann?  Ja. Gibt’s!  In unserer therapeutisch-pädagogischen Wohngruppe leben sieben Kinder und Jugendliche, die genau eines brauchen: Verlässliche Bezugspersonen, die Struktur stiften und echte Geborgenheit vermitteln. Machen wir uns nix vor. Unsere Kids schleppen alle eine heftige Biografie mit sich rum. Wir suchen deshalb keine Aufsichtskräfte für die bloße Verwahrung. Wir suchen Menschen, die den ganz normalen Alltagswahnsinn aktiv mitgestalten und Krisen als Beziehungsarbeit begreifen.

Sie sind da, wenn es brennt, fangen emotionale Ausbrüche auf und zeigen, wie faires Konfliktlösen in der Praxis funktioniert.

Das Setting lebt von Ihrer Persönlichkeit. Egal ob Musik, Sport oder Handwerk – Ihre eigenen Hobbys fließen direkt in den Gruppenalltag ein. Sie begleiten die Jugendlichen Schritt für Schritt in die Selbstständigkeit, unterstützen sie in der Schule, im Beruf und bei der eigenen Identitätsfindung.

Das Fundament unserer Arbeit beruht auf klar definierten Meilensteinen.

* Stabilisierung: Wir erarbeiten gemeinsam ein angemessenes Konfliktlösungsverhalten und stärken die Identität der Jugendlichen.

* Perspektive: Die Jugendlichen erhalten eine unterstützende Begleitung in Schule und Beruf für eine selbstbestimmte Zukunft.

Professioneller Einsatz verlangt exzellente Rahmenbedingungen.

Unsere Vergütung erfolgt nach den Strukturen des TVöD, ergänzt durch umfassende Zusatzleistungen.
Sie erhalten 30 Tage Urlaub :) plus zwei feste, zusätzliche Entlastungstage im Jahr. Für unserer aller Psychohygiene bieten wir regelmäßige Supervisionen und maßgeschneiderte Weiterbildungen an. Modernste Benefits wie ein persönliches Jobbike und das Deutschland-Ticket sichern Ihre Mobilität vor Ort. Ein echter Bonus unseres Trägers: Unser eigenes Ferienhaus in den Bergen steht dem Team für private Auszeiten zur Verfügung.

Lassen Sie uns reden. Direkt am Telefon oder bei einem Kaffee in der Gruppe.

title: Manager SAP Basis Solutions (m/w/d) (ERP-Berater/in - ERP-Consultant)
description:
Ihre nächste SAP-Basis-Rolle sollte mehr sein als der stabile Betrieb von Systemen.

Wenn Sie seit mehreren Jahren im SAP-Basis-Umfeld arbeiten, kennen Sie die klassischen Aufgaben:

Systeme überwachen.
Transporte steuern.
Störungen beheben.
Upgrades durchführen.
Den Betrieb stabil halten.

Alles wichtige Aufgaben.

Doch was wäre, wenn Ihre nächste Position Ihnen die Möglichkeit gibt, eine globale SAP-Landschaft aktiv weiterzuentwickeln und ihre technologische Zukunft mitzugestalten?

Für ein international aufgestelltes Unternehmen mit langfristiger, familiengeprägter Unternehmenskultur suchen wir einen erfahrenen Manager SAP Basis Solutions (m/w/d) am Standort Mannheim.

Die SAP-Landschaft umfasst SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA sowie moderne SAP-Plattformen und befindet sich in einer kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung hin zu einer stärker integrierten, sicheren und zukunftsfähigen Systemlandschaft.

Die Position richtet sich an jemanden, der über die klassische Administration hinaus Verantwortung übernehmen möchte, für Stabilität, Sicherheit, Performance, Automatisierung und technologische Weiterentwicklung.

Aufgaben

Was macht diese Position besonders?

Sie verantworten nicht einfach ein einzelnes SAP-System.

Sie arbeiten in einer globalen und sich weiterentwickelnden SAP-Plattformlandschaft und verbinden operativen Betrieb mit Technologie, Transformation und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

Ihre Aufgaben umfassen:

- Sicherstellung des stabilen, sicheren und performanten Betriebs der globalen SAP-Systemlandschaft inklusive SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA und weiterer SAP-Plattformen
- Operative SAP-Basisadministration mit Schwerpunkt auf Systemmonitoring, Transport-, Job-, Druck- und Schnittstellenmanagement sowie Performanceanalyse und Troubleshooting
- Planung und technische Umsetzung von Upgrades, Releasewechseln, Migrationen, Systemkopien, Templates und internationalen Rollout-Projekten
- Administration und Weiterentwicklung moderner SAP-Plattformen wie SAP NetWeaver, SAP HANA, SAP BTP, SAP Cloud ALM und SAP RISE Private Cloud Edition
- Koordination und fachliche Steuerung externer Dienstleister, Hosting-Provider und SAP-Berater sowie Sicherstellung der vereinbarten Servicequalität
- Technische Begleitung von SAP-Systemvermessungen sowie Analyse der SAP-Lizenznutzung zur Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen
- Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung und Automatisierung der SAP-Betriebsprozesse mit Fokus auf Verfügbarkeit, Security, Compliance, Performance und Zukunftsfähigkeit

Kurz gesagt:

Sie sorgen nicht nur dafür, dass die SAP-Landschaft heute funktioniert.
Sie helfen dabei, sie für morgen besser, sicherer und automatisierter zu machen.

Qualifikation

Was sollten Sie mitbringen?

Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit mit fundierter SAP-Basis-Expertise und Interesse an modernen SAP-Technologien.

Sie bringen idealerweise mit:

- Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung
- Praktische Erfahrung in der SAP-Basisadministration sowie im Betrieb komplexer SAP-ECC- und SAP-S/4HANA-Systemlandschaften
- Fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP NetWeaver und SAP HANA, insbesondere in Monitoring, Transportmanagement, Systemkopien, Upgrades, Migrationen und Troubleshooting
- Erfahrung mit hybriden SAP-Landschaften sowie modernen SAP-Technologien wie SAP BTP und SAP Cloud ALM; Kenntnisse in SAP RISE Private Cloud Edition sind von Vorteil
- Kenntnisse in SAP Security, Rollen und Berechtigungen, Zertifikatsmanagement, Hochverfügbarkeit sowie Backup- und Disaster-Recovery-Konzepten
- Erfahrung mit technischer SAP-Systemvermessung und der Bewertung der Lizenznutzung
- Erfahrung in der Koordination und fachlichen Steuerung externer Service Provider
- Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Sie müssen nicht jede einzelne Technologie perfekt beherrschen.

Wenn Sie eine solide SAP-Basis-Expertise mitbringen und Lust darauf haben, sich in eine moderne, international ausgerichtete SAP-Plattformlandschaft weiterzuentwickeln, freuen wir uns ebenfalls auf Ihre Kontaktaufnahme.

Benefits

Was erwartet Sie?

Sie arbeiten in einem global agierenden Unternehmen, das internationale Größe mit der langfristigen Orientierung eines familiengeprägten Geschäftsmodells verbindet.

Freuen Sie sich auf:

- Einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag
- Ein attraktives Gehaltspaket inklusive Unternehmenserfolgsbeteiligung
- Flexible Arbeitszeiten
- 2 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche
- 30 Tage Urlaub
- Eine globale SAP-Landschaft mit Einblicken in S/4HANA, HANA, BTP, Cloud ALM und RISE
- Die Möglichkeit, die Weiterentwicklung und Automatisierung des SAP-Betriebs aktiv mitzugestalten
- Individuelle Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten und umfangreiche Online-Lernangebote über einen eigenen LearningHub
- Eine moderne Arbeitsumgebung
- Zahlreiche Firmenparkplätze inklusive E-Ladesäulen
- Eine sehr gute Betriebskantine mit Frühstücks- und Mittagessensangebot
- Kostenfreien Kaffee, Tee und Wasser

Vielleicht suchen Sie gerade gar nicht.

Das ist vollkommen in Ordnung.

Erfahrene SAP-Basis-Spezialisten wechseln selten nur deshalb, weil irgendwo eine neue Stelle ausgeschrieben ist.

Der nächste Schritt muss einen echten Mehrwert bieten.

Vielleicht ist es die Möglichkeit, mit S/4HANA und modernen SAP-Plattformen zu arbeiten.

Vielleicht die Kombination aus technischer Verantwortung, globalem Umfeld und Transformation.

Oder vielleicht sind Sie einfach bereit für eine Position, in der Sie nicht nur auf Störungen reagieren, sondern aktiv mitentscheiden, wie sich die SAP-Landschaft weiterentwickelt.

Wenn Sie genau diese Art von Herausforderung interessant finden, freuen wir uns auf ein vertrauliches Gespräch.

Ohne Druck. Ohne Verpflichtung. Einfach die Möglichkeit, herauszufinden, ob die Position zu Ihrem nächsten Karriereschritt passen könnte.

Interesse geweckt?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung oder auf ein vertrauliches Gespräch über die Position und das technische Umfeld.

Wir freuen uns auf Sie.

- Dokumentation der Beratungsarbeit

title: Fullstack Engineer I, Dmarts – Quick Commerce (Fullstack-Entwickler/in)
description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

Code. Culture. Teamwork. As a Software Engineer I (Fullstack), you'll contribute to the systems that keep inventory moving across Delivery Hero's Quick Commerce supply chain — from purchase orders and store transfers to distribution center operations and WMS integrations. You'll work full-stack across Golang, Python and React, learning from experienced engineers while shipping features that directly support planners and operations teams every day.

Our team builds technology that enables inventory to move efficiently across our supply chain network (from procurement and replenishment to distribution centers, stores and other inventory movements). We develop systems used by planners and operational teams to manage Purchase Orders, Store Transfers, Cross Dock operations and Returns, while also building capabilities around Distribution Centers operations, inventory visibility and integrations with internal and external Warehouse Management Systems (WMS). Our tech stack goes from Golang and Python in the backend to React/Typescript on the frontend. We are progressively adopting Golang for new backend and event-driven components while continuing to evolve our existing Python services.

Be part of redefining how customers experience quick commerce. You'll help build technology that scales our non-food offerings, reaching new market segments and driving revenue growth. By innovating within our Quick Commerce Team, you'll make Delivery Hero the go-to platform for a broad range of products, helping us grow faster and deliver more value to customers around the world.

- Contribute to the development of fullstack applications, working across backend services (Golang/Python) and frontend interfaces (React)
- Work with experienced engineers to design and deliver features supporting inventory movements, Distribution Center operations and WMS integrations
- Build and consume REST APIs and event-driven integrations, including Kafka-based workflows
- Contribute throughout the software lifecycle, including implementation, automated testing, deployment, observability and production support
- Collaborate with engineers, product managers and operational stakeholders to understand problems and turn them into reliable software solutions
- Participate in code reviews and technical discussions, while continuously improving your knowledge of distributed systems, cloud technologies and software engineering practices

Qualifications

- Initial professional experience in software development through junior roles, internships, working student positions or relevant projects, with solid foundations in software design, data structures and algorithms
- Experience with at least one backend programming language; Golang or Python is particularly relevant, with an interest in developing further across both
- Familiarity with modern frontend development using Javascript/Typescript and React or a comparable framework
- Understanding of REST APIs, relational databases/SQL, Git and automated testing as part of modern software development
- A collaborative and proactive mindset, with willingness to work across the stack, learn from feedback, take increased ownership and use modern development practices and AI-assisted tooling responsibly

Nice to have

- Exposure to distributed or event-driven systems and message queues such as Kafka
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS) and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes)
- Awareness of CI/CD pipelines and observability practices in production environments

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan

title: Pflegefachkraft Bruder-Jordan-Haus Dortmund (w/m/d)  (Altenpfleger/in)
description:
Willst du nicht nur einen Job, sondern auch eine sinnvolle Aufgabe, bei der du Menschen in ihrem Alltag unterstützen und ihnen ein Stück Lebensqualität schenken kannst? Dann suchen wir genau dich als Pflegefachkraft für unser Altenzentrum Bruder-Jordan-Haus in Dortmund-Mitte. Bei uns erwartet dich ein Gehalt zwischen 2.867€ und 3.463 € im Monat und einen Arbeitgeber, die sich für dich einsetzt.

Deine Vorteile

- Top Gehalt nach Tarif AVR mit Jahressonderzahlung plus Zulagen
- Automatische Lohnsteigerungen und ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
- 30 Tage Urlaub (auf Basis einer 5-Tage-Woche) und diverse Erholungsextras
- Gut versorgt im Alter: betriebliche Altersvorsorge
- Vermögenswirksame Leistungen

- Ein engagiertes Team im Rücken, persönlicher Austausch und regelmäßige Mitarbeitendengespräche
- Fort- und Weiterbildungen, damit du auf dem Laufenden bleibst

- Welcome Day und Mitarbeitendenevents

Dein Stundenumfang

Du arbeitest in flexiblen Schichtmodellen 29,25 Stunden wöchentlich. Die Einstellung erfolgt zum nächstmöglichen Termin.

Dein Tag

- Dein Arbeitsplatz befindet sich in der stationären Pflege
- Im Umgang mit betreuungsbedürftigen Menschen bist du Profi
- Die Grund- und Behandlungspflege und das Medikamentenmanagement bewältigst du eigenständig und verantwortungsbewusst
- Du planst und überwachst gewissenhaft alle Pflegeprozesse
- Mit deiner Art und deiner Persönlichkeit bist du fähig, Menschen zu inspirieren und zu motivieren, entlang ihrer Möglichkeiten aktiv zu werden

- Für deine frisch examinierten Kolleg:innen im Team bist du gern Vorbild

Deine neue Arbeitgeberin

Werde Teil der Caritas Familie und gewinne 2.200 neue Arbeitskolleg:innen aus rund 50 verschiedenen Nationen dazu. Die Caritas Dortmund ist ein großer katholischer Wohlfahrtsverband. - Du bist examinierte Pflegefachkraft / Altenpfleger:in / Pflegefachfrau / Pflegefachmann / Gesundheits- oder Krankenpfleger:in / Krankenschwester
- Du hast bereits Erfahrungen im Bereich der stationären Pflege gesammelt
- Fachlich auf dem neusten Stand zu sein gehört für dich dazu
- Du bist teamorientiert und engagiert für eine ganzheitliche Pflege

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Csoportkoordinátor- Külső csomagolási projektek (Leiter/in - Logistik)
description:
Bevezetés

Részt venni a változás alakításában. Egy lépéssel megelőzni a holnap kihívásait már ma. Együtt növekedni egy fejlődő iparágban. Értékeink mentén, felelősen viselkedni. TÚLLÉPNI A HATÁROKAT. Ezt jelenti a DEUFOL csapatában dolgozni.
Világszerte 3 kontinensen, 12 ország 90 telephelyén, 2400 motivált munkatársunkkal, globális szereplők vagyunk az ellátási lánc megoldások és az ipari csomagolás területén.

Milyen feladatokra számíthatsz?

- Külső (a Deufol Hungary telephelyén kívül megvalósítandó) csomagolási és logisztikai projektek megvalósításának menedzsmentje az üzleti partnereink telephelyein (Debrecenen belül, illetve kívül, több változó helyszínen a régióban), a munkavállalók és a szakmai feladatok koordinálása
- A különféle külső helyszíneken az ipari termékek szakszerű, a megrendelésben meghatározott specifikációknak megfelelő csomagolásának, valamint a lecsomagolt termékek adminisztrációs, anyagmozgatási feladatainak biztosítása, a tevékenységek koordinálása
- Az ügyfélelégedettség biztosítása a külső csomagolási projektek során: egyeztetés a helyi kapcsolattartóval a helyszínen elvégzendő feladatokról, prioritásokról, reklamációs esetek kivizsgálása és részvétel a reakciós folyamatban.
- A külső csomagolási tevékenységekhez felhasznált csomagolóanyagok helyszínre történő kiszállítása céges autóval, szükség esetén fuvarszervezés
- A csapat tevékenységéhez kapcsolódó dokumentációs, riportolási és adminisztrációs feladatok ellátása a csoportvezető felé
- Együttműködés a cégen belüli társterületekkel, illetve a külső partnerekkel

Hozzád illik a pozíció, ha:

- Magabiztos, releváns tapasztalattal rendelkezel kisebb, néhány fős csapat vezetésében és koordinálásában gyártási, termelési, raktári, logisztikai területen
- Magabiztos számítógép-felhasználói ismeretekkel rendelkezel, gyakorlottan használod a MS Office alkalmazásokat; előny, ha valamilyen logisztikai, vállalatirányítási szoftver használatában van már tapasztalatod
- Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel; előny a szakirányú végzettség vagy tapasztalat logisztika, ellátási lánc menedzsment, ipari csomagolási, faipari, raktári területen
- Vállalod a külső helyszíneken történő munkavégzést, a rendszeres kiküldetéseket Magyarországon belül, illetve szükség esetén (várhatóan nagyon ritka esetben) külföldre is - a munkavégzésed helyszíne részben a Deufol Hungary székhelye, részben a különböző partnereink telephelyei lesznek
- Rendelkezel B kategóriás jogosítvánnyal és vezetési tapasztalattal
- Előnyt jelent, ha rendelkezel érvényes targoncavezetői vagy híddaru kezelői jogosítvánnyal
- Terhelhető, rugalmas vagy
- Önálló, felelősségteljes munkavégzés jellemez
- Jó kommunikációs, szervező- és problémamegoldó készséggel rendelkezel
- Pozitív, csapatjátékos és ügyfélközpontú hozzáállásod van
- Alapfokú aktív angol nyelvtudás előny (mindennapi munkahelyi helyzetekben tudod használni, pl. e-mailezés, egyszerű telefonhívások/helyszíni egyeztetések)

Hogyan tudunk inspirálni?

- Stabil cég vagyunk, hosszú távon számíthatsz ránk és mi is hosszú távon gondolkodunk benned
- 180 fős munkavállalói létszámunk biztosítja a közvetlen, támogató közeget, ahol a vezetők is mindig elérhetők
- Innovatív, növekvő nemzetközi vállalati környezetben dolgozhatsz
- Érdekes és felelősségteljes feladatokat végezhetsz, csapatban közösen és a saját tudásod, kreativitásod és személyiséged használva
- Piacnak megfelelő juttatási csomagga

title: Technischer Vertriebsaußendienst (m/w/d) – Marktentwicklung Ungarn (Elektroniker/in - Automatisierungs- und Systemtechnik)
description:
Sie kennen den ungarischen Markt, sind gerne bei Kunden vor Ort und begeistern sich für technische Lösungen?

Dann übernehmen Sie den weiteren Ausbau unseres Vertriebsgebietes in Ungarn. Sie gewinnen neue Kunden, entwickeln bestehende Geschäftsbeziehungen weiter und beraten Unternehmen zu unseren Dienstleistungen und Produkten. Dabei sind Sie im gesamten Land unterwegs und werden von einem erfahrenen Vertriebsteam in unserer Zentrale in Deutschland unterstützt.

- Faire & leistungsgerechte Bezahlung mit Bonusregelung
- Moderne Arbeitsausstattung mit Notebook und Smartphone
- Ein erfahrenes Vertriebsteam in unserer Zentrale als Backoffice-Unterstützung
- Viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein familiäres Arbeitsumfeld

Ihre Aufgaben - SPANNEND:

Sie…

- … gewinnen neue Kunden und bauen langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen auf
- … betreuen und entwickeln Bestandskunden im gesamten Vertriebsgebiet
- … beraten Unternehmen zu unseren technischen Dienstleistungen und Lösungen
- … erkennen Marktpotenziale und erschließen neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten
- … repräsentieren unser Unternehmen bei Kunden, Messen und Veranstaltungen

Ihre Qualifikationen - ÜBERZEUGEND:

- Ungarisch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie gute Deutsch-, gerne auch Englischkenntnisse
- Erfahrung im technischen B2B-Vertrieb oder Außendienst
- Freude an der Neukundengewinnung und dem Ausbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen
- Technisches Verständnis für erklärungsbedürftige Produkte oder Dienstleistungen
- Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Ungarns

Darauf können Sie sich freuen - INFORMATIV:

- Intensive Einführungsphase in der Zentrale mit Abteilungsrotation & Tandembesuchen im Außendienst
- Spannende Projekte mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Eigenverantwortung
- Individuell abgestimmte Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- Langfristige Perspektive in einem international erfolgreichen Familienunternehmen

Seit 1987 sind wir löwenstark am Markt – innovativ, familiär und zukunftsorientiert.

Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen mit Sitz in Hanau gehören wir zu den führenden Spezialisten für Reparatur, Verkauf und Service von CNC-, SPS- und Robotertechnik sowie Elektronik für erneuerbare Energien, Maritimer Elektronik sowie Elektronik in der Gebäudetechnik. Wir halten Maschinen am Laufen – weltweit.

Werden Sie Teil unseres #löwenstarkenteams und gestalten Sie den Ausbau unseres Vertriebs in Ungarn aktiv mit.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Assistant driller
description:
Seeking an assistant driller

Iceland Drilling Company (IDC) is an international leader in geothermal drilling, committed to providing safe and efficient drilling solutions with a focus on sustainability. We take pride in operating advanced, automatic drilling rigs that create a safe and positive working environment for our highly motivated crew members.

Key Responsibilities:
• Responsibility for correct mud tank settings, mixing mud and mud additives, measurement of specific gravity and viscosity of mud, monitior and cleaning mud pumps and pits.
• Trip in – lubricating threads and assisting with drill string assembly and removal of drill string.
• Receipt, measurement and cleaning of casings, assisting with casing assembly.
• Installation and arrangement of BOP‘s.
• Assisting with cementing.
• Reception and clearing up of drilling equipment (drill bits, stabilizers, jars, mud motors, MWD‘s etc).
• Substitute for driller/assistant driller as needed.

Qualifications & Requirements:
• Experience within geothermal drilling is preferred. Experience with Drillmec or Bentec rigs strongly preferred. Experince as Derrickman. 2 years minimum Assistant Driller experience highly preferred.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong problem-solving and initiative, fluency in English. Good experince operating powertools.
• Valid driver's license. Icelandic forklift license (preferred). IWCF license, level 1-2 preferred. Forklift license for 10 tons + preferred.
• Proactive approach to hazard identification and control. Ability to work effectively in remote and demanding environments. Ability to work under pressure and in challenging environments.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make quick decisions.
• Safety-conscious with a commitment to maintaining high safety standard.

Employer can assist with housing.

Full time job – shift work; work arrangements vary depending on the project.
Wages according to collective agreements with Framsýn workers union.

Please apply by sending your application and CV to: jons@jardboranir.is.
Last application date is October 31, 2026.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Graphics Programmer
description:
CCP is looking for a Graphics Programmer with a deep passion for games and visual craft to join the EVE Online art team in our Reykjavík studio.

You will work closely with artists and engineers to bring stunning visuals to life, developing shaders, rendering features, and tools that directly shape the look and feel of EVE Online.

The position is located in Reykjavík, Iceland.

Your Tasks:
Design and implement new graphical features, shaders, and visual solutions that enhance EVE Online’s signature look.
Work closely with artists to understand their needs and deliver tools and workflows that empower their creativity.
Contribute to improvements in real-time rendering quality and visual performance.
Identify and resolve graphics performance issues in collaboration with the team.
Deliver new features and improve existing visual systems, prioritizing and breaking down tasks to meet deadlines.

Your Profile:

Experience or strong interest in developing internal tools and pipeline automation to support artists.

title: Senior QA Analyst
description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.
Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.
Annual sports grant.
A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.
Home internet.
A conditional monthly transportation grant.
Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.
On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.
Relocation Package.

title: QA On The Floor Specialist
description:
Alvotech hf is seeking a QA On the floor specialist.

Join Alvotech’s Quality Assurance team and play a key role in supporting manufacturing operations while ensuring compliance with GMP requirements and quality standards. This hands-on position provides real-time QA support to manufacturing teams and contributes to the delivery of high-quality biopharmaceutical products.

Please note that this is a rotational shift position, requiring flexibility to support manufacturing operations across designated shifts in a 24/7 production environment.

Scope and Responsibilities:

- Act as the primary QA contact for DPM and DSM operations during rotational shifts.
- Provide QA support for batch-related and facility issues, including deviations and CAPAs.
- Perform shop floor monitoring and ensure compliance with GMP, GDP, and ALCOA principles.
- Review manufacturing documentation, alarm logs, and failure assessments.
- Approve area release, line clearance, and other QA-controlled activities.
- Support media fills, cell bank issuance, AQL sampling, and visual inspection activities.
- Maintain QA documentation and support inspection readiness and audits.
- Contribute to SOP updates and train new QA team members as needed.

Job Requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, or a related field.
- Minimum 2 years of experience in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical or biotechnology manufacturing environment.
- Strong knowledge of GMP, quality systems, documentation practices, GDP, and ALCOA principles.
- Experience supporting manufacturing operations and quality oversight activities.
- Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
- Ability to work rotational shifts in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
- Proficient in written and spoken English.

What we offer:

- An inspiring challenge to work with great co-workers on ambitious projects that change people's lives.
- The chance to be a part of a global and fast-growing company.
- An international work culture that encourages diversity, collaboration, and inclusion.
- Positive, flexible, and innovative work environment.
- Support for personal growth and internal career development.
- Company social events and milestone celebrations.
- Excellent in-house canteen and coffee house.

title: QC Bioassay Principal Scientist
description:
We are searching for a motivated and detail oriented QC Bioassay Principal Scientist to support quality control testing activities for biosimilars. This role is responsible for executing and troubleshooting cell based potency assay, ensuring compliance with regulatory and GMP standards, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives within the QC laboratory.



Key Responsibility:

Independently accountable for completing assigned tasks and deliverables, while receiving direction and assignments from a supervisor.

Demonstrates in-depth knowledge and proficiency in Bioassay (cell-based potency assays, ELISA, binding assays etc).

Executing and troubleshooting cell based potency assays. Provide good technical input for Invalid assays investigations.

Executes non‑routine activities, including deviations, change controls, CAPAs, and related investigation actions.

Prepare testing protocols and reports, and review laboratory and cell bank documentation.

Analyze, interpret, and document experimental data in line with ALCOA+ data integrity standards.

Support qualification and optimization of critical reagents (e.g., reference materials) and technical troubleshooting

Challenges and decisions are addressed collaboratively with cross‑functional teams, with solutions developed in partnership with the supervisor and other team members.

Possesses expert knowledge of cell‑based assays, including relevant methods, techniques and associated procedural and process requirements.

Provide technical training and support to team members and ensure proper understanding of laboratory methods and procedural requirements as needed.

Support technology transfer and validation activities by contributing to the preparation and review of technical documents.

Personally, authors and reviews key analytical sections related to potency methods within regulatory submissions, as well as responses to queries from health authorities and external partners.

Requires familiarity with ALCOA+ principles to uphold data integrity in regulated environments, ensuring records are accurate, traceable, and audit ready.



Qualifications and experience:

Master’s degree or Ph.D in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Biology, or a related field.

Minimum 8 years previous experience with Potency/ cell-based assays. Knowledge and experience of working to GMP standards.

Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

Communication skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Computer literacy: Proficient in use of a PC and common Microsoft packages such as Word, Excel.

Excellent command of the English language, both written and verbal.

description:
Prentmet Oddi leitar að ábyrgðarmiklum, nákvæmum og metnaðarfullum starfsmanni til að sinna starfi prentara.
Um er að ræða fjölbreytt og krefjandi starf í öflugu framleiðsluumhverfi þar sem gæði, þjónusta og fagmennska eru í fyrirrúmi.

Helstu verkefni:
Stýra og hafa umsjón með offsetprentvél.
Úttekt og samanburður prófarka og prentarka til að tryggja gæði framleiðslu.
Umsjón með viðhaldi véla og útfylling viðhaldsbókar.
Veita svör og ráðgjöf varðandi prentun og tæknileg atriði.
Umhirða og frágangur vinnuaðstöðu.
Önnur tilfallandi verkefni tengd starfssviðinu.

Reynsla af offsetprentun eða sambærilegri framleiðslu er kostur.
Góð tæknileg þekking og hæfni til að vinna sjálfstætt.
Nákvæmni, skipulagshæfni og öguð vinnubrögð.
Jákvætt viðhorf og góð samstarfshæfni.
Áhugi á gæðum og stöðugum umbótum.

Launakjör fara eftir reynslu, þekkingu og hæfni umsækjanda.
Starfið fellur undir kjarasamning Grafíu.
Vinnutími er frá 08:00 til 16:00 virka daga, en til 15:30 á föstudögum.

Prentmet Oddi er stærsti framleiðandi landsins á kartonumbúðum, almennu prentverki og bókum. title: Senior QA Analyst
description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.
Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.
Annual sports grant.
A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.
Home internet.
A conditional monthly transportation grant.
Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.
On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.
Relocation Package.

Please submit your application in English.

title: Technical Sales Specialist - Island of Ireland (Restaurator/in im Steinmetz- und Steinbildhauerhandwerk/Master Professional für Restaurierung im Handwerk)
description:
Introduction

Elementar UK, part of the Elementar Group, is responsible for the sales and support of the expanding range of Elemental Analysers and related instruments in the UK as well as being an award-winning manufacturer of Isotope Ratio Mass Spectrometer (IRMS) systems covering a diverse and exciting range of applications.

We research and develop for basic human needs: Our devices ensure quality of life and are used when it comes to water, food, education, health, the environment, climate, energy or product quality.

We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially driven Technical Sales Specialist to generate sustainable and profitable growth for Elementar products and services. This is an exciting opportunity to drive the growth of Elementar's innovative solutions across Ireland and Northern Ireland, taking ownership of a high-potential territory and building lasting customer partnerships.

This is a remote-based role for someone passionate about scientific instrumentation, value-led selling, and developing long-term customer relationships in a technical, solution-focused environment. You will play a key role in expanding our presence by combining strong commercial acumen with a genuine curiosity for scientific and industrial applications.

You’ll work closely with our team in Greater Manchester, where our facilities support the assembly and testing, and house a dedicated Application lab and full R&D team, providing the expertise and resources needed to deliver exceptional customer solutions.

Duties & Responsibilities

In this role, you will take full ownership of the sales cycle - from prospecting through to closing business and nurturing long-term customer relationships. You will actively develop new sales opportunities by understanding customer needs and applying our technologies to deliver value-driven solutions.

A key part of your role will be presenting both technical and commercial arguments with clarity and confidence, demonstrating how our products and services solve real-world challenges.

You will develop and execute a local business plan in partnership with the Sales Manager, ensuring alignment with growth targets and market opportunities. You'll use market insights and industry trends to identify opportunities, shape local strategy and drive continued growth across your territory, while maintaining accurate sales reporting and forecasting.

Working closely with local service and support teams & the application lab, you will deliver an outstanding customer experience from product demonstration through to after-sales support, while contributing to wider UK sales initiatives when required.

Experience, Essential Skills and Person

We are looking for someone with a degree in a scientific or engineering discipline (or equivalent experience) and at least 5 years’ experience in scientific instrumentation sales or a strong background in technical commercial environments. Experience working with CRM systems such as SAP would be advantageous.

The ideal candidate have a proven track record of winning new business through value-led selling and the ability to identify and convert opportunities within a technical sales environment. You will thrive in an autonomous role, balancing strategic territory development with effective pipeline management to consistently deliver results.

You will possess strong communication skills and be equally comfortable engaging with scientific specialists and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex concepts into meaningful customer value. You should be confident in negotiation, resilient in the face of challenges, and committed to delivering excellent customer experiences. A collaborative mindset, adaptability, and a proactive approach to problem-solving are key to success in this role.

Collaborare con Customer Service, area tecnica/servizi e marketing per garantire continuità end-to-end. Partecipare a fiere, eventi e visite presso clienti e partner. Migliorare processi commerciali (pricing, marginalità, standard offerta, governance sconti). Requisiti = 5 anni in ruoli commerciali B2B, preferibilmente in contesti tecnici/industriali o vendita consulenziale. Utilizzo concreto del CRM per pipeline, attività e monitoraggio risultati. Capacità di contribuire a budget commerciale, lettura KPI e attivazione di azioni correttive. Buona padronanza di pricing, gestione offerte, scontistica e condizioni commerciali. Attenzione a marginalità e redditività, bilanciando crescita e tutela dei margini. Esperienza (anche su piccoli team) in coordinamento e leadership. Inglese buono (scritto e parlato). Disponibilità a trasferte nazionali. Plus: provenienza da automazione industriale, componentistica elettrica/elettronica, sicurezza industriale. Cosa offriamo Ruolo strategico con impatto diretto sulla crescita e sulla trasformazione organizzativa dell'area commerciale. Autonomia decisionale e confronto costante con la Direzione Generale. Inserimento nel board aziendale. Contesto giovane, collaborativo, orientato alla qualità e con cultura 'zero frizioni'. Team interno + rete agenti già attivi, da guidare e sviluppare. title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e creare sinergie commerciali a mercato per l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture. Ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Responsabilità principali - Definire roadmap, posizionamento e 'pacchetti' dei servizi commerciali satellite enabled. - Disegnare e lanciare offerte wholesale: modelli di partnership, livelli di servizio (SLA) e pricing. - Raccogliere esigenze da clienti/partner e tradurle in requisiti operativi e deliverable per i team coinvolti. - Identificare verticali prioritari, sviluppare opportunità commerciali e portare i pilot a contratti ricorrenti. - Selezionare e validare componenti e partner necessari all'erogazione del servizio (dispositivi/terminali e servizi di piattaforma/ground). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale Location: Milano, Italia Package: RAL 70-100K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio #LI-CP Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. description: Per grande azienda industriale, ricerchiamo un Senior IT Service Desk che contribuirà alla continuità operativa degli uffici e degli stabilimenti produttivi, assicurando un supporto informatico tempestivo ed efficace agli utenti. La posizione prevede un ruolo operativo, con autonomia nella gestione delle richieste e capacità di definire le priorità in funzione dell'impatto sulle attività aziendali e sulla produzione. Familiarità con strumenti di ticketing, assistenza remota e principi di sicurezza informatica. Capacità di lavorare in autonomia, comunicare con utenti di diverse funzioni e gestire le priorità con un approccio pratico e orientato al servizio. title: elettricista nel settore dell’illuminazione pubblica
description: The future of automation needs your hands. And your brain. Do you have a natural passion for mechanics, electronics, and technology? Does the thrill of troubleshooting a fault, solving the issue, and watching an entire industrial plant scale back up to speed get you excited? title: segretario/segretaria
description: On behalf of the Italian Entrepreneurial Holding of a growing international Group, we are looking for a Consolidation & Reporting Manager. Reporting directly to the Corporate Finance Manager, this is a stand-alone role. The successful candidate will actively contribute to building Group accounting processes and must possess comprehensive knowledge of IFRS principles. Key Responsibilities Preparation of monthly and annual consolidated financial statements, including adjusting and consolidation entries. Reconciliation of intercompany accounts and elimination entries, including the investigation and resolution of reconciliation variances. Translation of foreign subsidiaries' financial statements and management of foreign exchange differences. Management of changes in the consolidation scope, including acquisitions, mergers, takeovers, and corporate reorganizations. Support in accounting for Purchase Price Allocation (PPA), goodwill, and consolidation differences, where applicable. Preparation of reporting packages and accounting instructions for Group companies. Analysis of data submitted by subsidiaries, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency, and managing detailed follow-up requests. Support in preparing the consolidated Notes to the Financial Statements and documentation for auditors and corporate governance bodies. Liaison with the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team to ensure consistency between management reporting and consolidated financial data. Liaison with the administrative teams of foreign subsidiaries, providing support for accounting and administrative activities. Requirements Degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in Group Consolidation, Financial Reporting, External Audit, or Corporate Accounting. Previous experience within multinational listed companies or top-tier audit and advisory firms. Strong knowledge of IAS/IFRS Proven ability to manage complex reporting activities under tight deadlines Fluent English, both written and spoken, used regularly in a professional environment. Knowledge of USGAAP and experience with Oracle are a plus Offer Permanent employment Contract RAL between €50,000 and €60,000 1 day of remote working per week #LI-AM2

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.

Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt
- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich
- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour
- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

Interesse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Grundkenntnisse: Gästebetreuung, Fahrzeugführung, Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Technisches Verständnis

Il percorso è pensato per persone disoccupate o inattive che vogliono acquisire competenze pratiche e spendibili per lavorare nel front office di hotel, strutture ricettive e realtà del settore turistico-alberghiero. Non si tratta di un'offerta di lavoro, ma di un percorso formativo gratuito finalizzato a sviluppare competenze professionali utili per inserirsi o reinserirsi nel settore dell'ospitalità, dell'accoglienza e dei servizi alberghieri. Cosa imparerai durante il corso Durante il percorso acquisirai competenze legate alle principali attività del Front Office alberghiero, tra cui: gestione delle prenotazioni e del booking; accoglienza e assistenza degli ospiti; attività di reception e check-in; guest experience e servizi di concierge; comunicazione con clienti e reparti della struttura; utilizzo dei principali software di gestione alberghiera; English for Tourism; pricing e revenue management; strumenti digitali e Intelligenza Artificiale applicata all'hospitality; conoscenza e valorizzazione del territorio. Il percorso ufficiale è infatti finalizzato allo sviluppo delle competenze relative a Acquisire le prenotazioni, Gestione dell'accoglienza e Gestione dei flussi informativi. Il corso prevede 373 ore complessive, articolate in: 184 ore di formazione teorico-pratica 181 ore di stage 8 ore di accompagnamento Lo stage rappresenta quindi una componente centrale del percorso e permette di mettere in pratica le competenze acquisite direttamente all'interno di aziende e strutture ricettive del territorio. La ripartizione delle ore è quella prevista dal progetto approvato. A chi è rivolto Il percorso è rivolto a cittadini/e maggiorenni, disoccupati/e o inattivi/e, interessati a sviluppare una professionalità nel settore turistico-alberghiero. Sono disponibili 15 posti. Sede del corso FARE LAVORO Scarl Via Sandro Pertini 24/26 - Firenze Indennità e rimborsi È prevista un'indennità di frequenza pari a €3,50 per ogni ora di formazione, fino a un massimo di €250 per partecipante. Sono inoltre previsti il rimborso delle spese di trasporto e vitto secondo quanto stabilito dall'Avviso. Per informazioni e supporto alla candidatura Riccardo Foti riccardo.foti@farelavoro.com Tel. 3495710454 www.farelavoro.com I posti disponibili sono limitati: richiedi subito le informazioni per verificare i requisiti e completare l'iscrizione. - Disclaimer legale Facciamo parte di Gi Group Holding (www.gigroupholding.it ) la prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, nonché una delle principali realtà a livello mondiale nei servizi dedicati allo sviluppo del mercato del lavoro. title: conduttore di macchine per la trafila di metalli/conduttrice di macchine per la trafila di metalli
description: Hai esperienza come tecnico elettrico? Cerchi una nuova opportunità lavorativa in cui mettere in pratica le tue competenze tecniche? Gi Pro Mechanics 4.0 è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito meccanico, meccatronico ed elettromeccanico COLLABORA CON C.A.B.I. Cattaneo SPA, azienda che opera dal 1936 a Milano nel campo dei veicoli subacquei e dei sistemi subacquei speciali per la Marina Militare. Progetta, realizza e mantiene in efficienza i prodotti durante l'intero ciclo di vita, gestendone anche l'integrazione con nuovi sistemi per il continuo ammodernamento. Cerchiamo la figura di CABLATORE/MONTATORE ELETTRICO che si occuperà di montaggio, cablaggio, messa a punto e collaudo dei gruppi elettrici ed elettronici dei nostri sistemi subacquei. Quali saranno le tue attività? - Esegue in autonomia i processi di montaggio e cablaggio durante l'allestimento dei gruppi secondo gli standard qualitativi di processo, segnalando eventuali difetti e possibili miglioramenti al proprio responsabile - Mette a punto elettricamente ed elettronicamente i sottogruppi assemblati, ottimizzando l'integrazione ed il funzionamento dei sistemi. - Analizza il guasto di natura elettrica ed elettronica e ripara i gruppi sottoposti a riparazione e/o revisione. - Allestisce banchi prova elettrici ed elettronici per il collaudo dei gruppi assemblati e assiste la conduzione della sala prova su motori termici ed elettrici, secondo specifiche tecniche o istruzioni operative. - Controlla la qualità e conformità dei materiali di acquisto (parte elettrica) e compila la documentazione di competenza di qualità e di produzione. Must have: - Diploma tecnico (perito elettrotecnico, elettronico o indirizzo affine) o formazione equivalente. - Esperienza pregressa in mansione analoga: montaggio e cablaggio di gruppi o quadri, ricerca guasti e riparazione. - Ottima manualità nella saldatura a stagno di componenti elettronici e capacità di eseguire saldature pulite, lucide e prive di difetti - Conoscenza del disegno e delle normative tecniche: lettura di schemi elettrici e distinte di cablaggio. - Disponibilità a brevi trasferte Nice to have: - Qualifica PES/PAV secondo la norma CEI 11-27 per i lavori elettrici (art. 82, D.Lgs. 81/2008). Offerta Contrattuale: - Inserimento diretto in azienda a tempo indeterminato con CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria (CNEL C011) - La retribuzione prevista è compresa tra € 34.000 e 40.000 lordi annui (definita in base all'inquadramento contrattuale, alle mansioni previste e alle caratteristiche della posizione) - Livello di inserimento: livello D2/C1 - Orario lavoro: dalle 08.00 alle 17.00 - dal lunedì al venerdì - 40 ore settimanali Benefit: - Premio di risultato aziendale annuale di massimo 2.900€ - Mensa aziendale gratuita - Welfare con flexible benefit fino a 2.000€ l'anno (importo da concordare al momento dell'offerta) - Assistenza fiscale gratuita Luogo di lavoro: Milano - zona Ovest Facciamo parte di Gi Group Holding (www.gigroupholding.it) la prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro e una tra le principali realtà che offrono servizi e consulenza HR a livello globale. Cerchiamo un professionista con una buona seniority tecnica e una visione trasversale della sicurezza, capace di andare oltre la gestione operativa degli incidenti e contribuire all'evoluzione dell'ecosistema Cyber aziendale. Principali responsabilità La persona sarà coinvolta in attività quali: supporto a nuovi progetti IT e Software secondo principi di Security by Design, attraverso security review e definizione dei requisiti di sicurezza; definizione ed evoluzione dei controlli di Cloud Security, principalmente in ambienti Microsoft Azure e AWS; presidio delle tematiche di Identity Security, con particolare riferimento a Microsoft Entra ID e Active Directory; valutazione e scouting di nuove tecnologie e servizi messi a disposizione dai principali cloud e security provider; evoluzione dei servizi di Cyber Security Monitoring, collaborando con il SOC esterno e contribuendo al tuning delle piattaforme SIEM e dei relativi controlli di detection; attività di Vulnerability Management su componenti infrastrutturali e applicative; evoluzione dei presidi di sicurezza relativi a Firewall, WAF, endpoint, infrastrutture e ambienti Cloud; supporto ad attività di Incident Response e miglioramento continuo dei relativi processi e controlli; partecipazione alla definizione di iniziative di Purple Teaming, finalizzate all'identificazione delle aree di miglioramento della postura difensiva; confronto con Software Architect, Service Manager, team IT e Business per integrare i requisiti Cyber all'interno di nuovi servizi e applicazioni; supporto, quando necessario, nel confronto con clienti enterprise sui presidi di sicurezza adottati nei servizi erogati. Profilo ricercato Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza in ambito Cyber Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security o Security Architecture, maturata in contesti aziendali strutturati o all'interno di società di consulenza tecnologica. Non è necessario aver maturato esperienza approfondita in tutte le aree indicate. Sarà particolarmente interessante una solida competenza in una o più delle seguenti: Cloud Security in ambienti Azure e/o AWS; Identity & Access Security, Entra ID / Active Directory; Security Engineering e definizione di security controls; Cyber Security Monitoring e tecnologie SIEM/XDR; Vulnerability Management; Infrastructure & Network Security; Application Security / Security by Design. Saranno considerate un plus esperienze in ambito Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Security, Incident Response, Purple Teaming e attività di security assessment. È richiesta una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Offerta RAL indicativa: €50.000 - €60.000 + MBO, valutabile in funzione dell'esperienza; inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato; modalità di lavoro ibrida con 2 giorni alla settimana in presenza a Bologna; #LI-AM2

description: Grafton Office è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Per azienda produttiva del settore moda manifatturiero di Ferrara (FE) selezioniamo una figura di: RESPONSABILE AMMINISTRAZIONE DEL PERSONALE & PAYROLL Verrai inserito/a all'interno del dipartimento di Risorse Umane & Servizi Generali dell'azienda e coordinerai le attività di 1 HR Administration Specialist. Di cosa ti occuperai nello specifico? Gestire l'amministrazione HR, garantire l'integrità dei dati e la corretta tenuta dei fascicoli del personale, assicurando la piena conformità alle comunicazioni obbligatorie, alla gestione degli infortuni e ai requisiti di legge. Supervisionare il processo payroll in coordinamento con il provider esterno, garantendo puntualità, accuratezza, conformità normativa e una gestione efficace delle richieste dei dipendenti. Gestire presenze e assenze tramite il sistema Zucchetti, assicurando un tracciamento preciso delle ore lavorate e il rispetto delle policy aziendali. Preparare statistiche analitiche e reportistica interna e di Gruppo (headcount, report mensili/annuali, assenteismo, gestione ferie, straordinari), fornendo insight data-driven a supporto delle decisioni HR. Supervisionare i contratti di lavoro in conformità alle normative vigenti, mantenendosi aggiornati sulle evoluzioni legislative e implementando le necessarie revisioni di policy e procedure. Supportare la definizione, il monitoraggio e la revisione del budget annuale del personale in linea con le linee guida aziendali e di Gruppo, oltre all'analisi continuativa dei costi HR. Contribuire ai processi annuali di salary review e di compensazione variabile, sulla base delle valutazioni di performance e delle linee guida stabilite. Promuovere e implementare soluzioni innovative di HRIS per migliorare l'efficienza operativa dei processi HR strategici. Hai queste competenze tecniche? Laurea in Economia, Consulenza del Lavoro o similari. Esperienza di almeno 7 anni in funzione di HR Administration, con focus specifico su payroll e gestione del budget. Ottima conoscenza di tematiche di Payroll, Compensation & Benefits, legislazione del lavoro e gestione amministrativa correlata. Ottima padronanza di Microsoft Excel e esperienza con sistemi HRIS (la conoscenza di Zucchetti e SuccessFactors è considerata un plus). Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese (la conoscenza del francese è considerata un plus). description: Il nostro cliente è uno dei principali System Integrator italiani specializzati in Networking, Data Center, Security e soluzioni Cloud, con una forte componente di progettazione infrastrutturale e una lunga storia nel mondo delle telecomunicazioni. Ci ha incaricati di ricercare un/a Senior Pre Sales Engineer - Networking che verrà inserito/a all'interno della Technology Unit NDCS della Business Unit PPS (Public & Private Sector) e opererà nell'area di Prevendita, contribuendo alla definizione di soluzioni innovative in ambito Networking, Data Center, Security e Cloud per clienti Enterprise e Pubblica Amministrazione. L'obiettivo del ruolo è supportare le strutture commerciali nella qualificazione delle opportunità, nella progettazione delle soluzioni e nella predisposizione delle offerte tecnico-economiche, collaborando con vendor, partner e team di delivery. Requisiti - Esperienza di almeno 8-10 anni in attività specifiche nel ruolo di cui al profilo richiesto - Esperienza nella definizione di soluzioni complesse. - Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. - Disponibilità a trasferte. description:

  • montaža cjevovoda po tehničkom nacrtu izometrije na industrijskim postrojenjima (bijele cijevi od 2-4 mm),
  • samostalno, točno izračunavanje svih segmenata po izometriji
Prednost:
  • iskustvo rada u kemijskim industrijama, termoelektranama, industrije papira i dr.
  • poznavanje tehničkog nacrta – izometrije
Trenutno kombinacija poslova na terenu Njemačka, Italija i proizvodni pogon Sigetec Ludbreški. Iznimno konkurentni uvjeti, plaća ovisi da li je teren ili proizvodnja u HR. Poslodavac osigurava:
  • iznadprosječna primanja i stimulacije za ostvarene rezultate
  • plaćen smještaj
  • organiziran prijevoz službenim vozilom
  • dugoročan i stabilan radni odnos
  • bonusi za inicijative, jubilarne nagrade i darovi, Uskrsnice, Božićnice i bogati dječji darovi
  • stalnu podršku 24/7 od strane tima matične tvrtke Inoxmont-VS

description:
