Telecom R&D Engineer - NTN

With our groundbreaking satellite 5G constellation, OQ Technology is a global leader in IoT connectivity and next-generation satellite communication services. As a venture-backed company with a proven track record of satellite launches, we are the first in the world to integrate cellular 5G with satellites, enabling seamless connectivity for devices in remote and underserved regions. Our technology supports transformative applications across industries such as Oil & Gas, Maritime, Industry 4.0, and Transport, extending reliable connectivity through Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN). To support the continued development of our advanced telecommunications platform, we are looking for a Telecom R&D Engineer - NTN to join our team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and optimization of 3GPP-based protocol stacks and NTN adaptations for NB-IoT, LTE, and 5G NR technologies, helping bring cutting-edge satellite connectivity solutions from research to real-world deployment.

Key responsibilities

• Contribute to the research, development, and adaptation of L1/L2/L3 protocol stack components for Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) supporting NB-IoT, LTE, and 5G NR technologies.
• Participate in the full R&D lifecycle, including system design, implementation, integration, testing, and performance optimization.
• Analyze, troubleshoot, and enhance protocol stack behavior across multiple layers, including PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, and NAS.
• Investigate and implement NTN-specific adaptations required for satellite communications, including aspects related to propagation delay, Doppler effects, and timing synchronization.
• Design and execute testing and validation procedures, including unit testing, system integration testing, and performance benchmarking.
• Contribute to software integration and deployment workflows, including continuous integration and version control practices.
• Stay up to date with 3GPP standardization developments (e.g., NTN features in Releases 17/18/19) and contribute to translating standards into practical implementations.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including RF, FPGA, satellite systems, and platform engineering to integrate telecom stacks with hardware and system components.
• Support system-level analysis and debugging, including log analysis, KPI evaluation, and protocol trace inspection.

Basic qualifications

• An academic degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in telecom R&D, preferably working with 3GPP-based wireless systems.
• Solid understanding of 3GPP protocol architecture and procedures in NB-IoT, LTE, or 5G NR.
• Strong programming skills in C/C++, with additional scripting experience in Python for automation and analysis.
• Experience working in Linux/Unix environments with standard development and debugging tools.
• Familiarity with software development workflows, including version control (e.g., Git) and CI/CD practices. • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex system-level issues.
• Good communication and collaboration skills in a multidisciplinary engineering environment.
• Proficiency in spoken and written English.
• IMPORTANT: Candidate must already reside in Europe or hold a valid European residence permit.

Preferred skills and experience

• Hands-on experience with 3GPP wireless systems, particularly NB-IoT, LTE, or 5G NR implementations.
• Experience working with NTN architectures and protocol adaptations defined in 3GPP specifications.
• Practical experience analyzing and modifying protocol stack components across L1/L2/L3 layers (PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, NAS).
• Familiarity with core network signalling protocols, such as S1AP, NGAP, and GTP-C/U.
• Experience working with software-defined radio platforms (e.g., USRP) or open telecom stacks such as srsRAN and OpenAirInterface, or Open5GS and free5GC.
• Knowledge of O-RAN architecture and functional split concepts.
• Familiarity with Small Cell Forum (SCF) interfaces, including FAPI/nFAPI.
• Background in embedded or real-time software development, particularly on ARM-based or heterogeneous platforms.
• Experience with protocol debugging, KPI analysis, and system performance optimization in wireless communication systems.

Additional Information:  As part of the recruitment process, candidates may be required to provide a criminal record certificate issued within the last three (3) months.

• Regular company events and team activities.

Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
Within the FSTM, the Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (DHML) coordinates all teaching programmes in life in sciences, medicine, nursing, radiology and midwifery. The department's research combines basic and translational, molecular and computational approaches, with a particular focus on cancer biology, while also encompassing clinical research in human health and disease.
The DHML cooperates with the national health care centers and leading international biomedical research institutions. As medicine and health are strategic priorities for the University of Luxembourg, the department is actively expanding its education and research activities in these fields, providing exceptional opportunities for medical and biomedical initiatives.

Your role
The position focuses on innovative, interdisciplinary teaching in public health at the bachelor's level and within health-related specialization programmes. The recruited professor will establish teaching and expertise in areas such as epidemiology, health systems, disease prevention, and health policy.
The successful candidate will lead the development and coordination of public health teaching activities across the University's programmes in medicine, nursing sciences, and midwifery. The role includes the implementation of a state-of-the-art public health curriculum, incorporating advanced educational tools such as digital learning platforms, data-driven health simulations, case-based learning, and interactive policy analysis. Working closely with faculty members and clinical partners, the successful candidate will ensure an integrated and cohesive learning experience for students.

Research Portfolio
The candidate is expected to have an internationally recognised research profile and to bring a coherent research programme in public health. The candidate will develop and lead an ambitious research agenda in areas such as population health, primary care, prevention, health systems, epidemiology, health inequalities, data driven health sciences, and digital health.

Policy and Practice Integration
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in public health research and/or practice, with a commitment to integrating real-world perspectives into education. This will enhance the practical application of public health principles in healthcare and policy contexts. The possibility of maintaining collaborative activities with national health authorities or international organizations may be considered, depending on the candidate's profile and institutional partnerships.

For further information about the role, please contact: Serge Haan, Head of DHML, Email: serge.haan@uni.lu


Your profile
• MD/PhD or PhD in Public Health, Epidemiology, Health Systems, or a closely related field. An MD is considered an asset
• Extensive experience in public health research and/or practice, ideally with a strong track record in population health, primary care, health policy, or health systems analysis
• Substantial teaching experience in public health, epidemiology, or health sciences at undergraduate and/or postgraduate levels, preferably within medical, nursing, or life sciences programs
• Proven commitment to interdisciplinary and innovative teaching, particularly in integrating public health with medicine, life sciences, and nursing
• Demonstrated ability to design and implement new educational courses, including modules on health systems, epidemiology, and preventive strategies
• Familiarity with modern teaching methods and tools, such as online learning platforms, simulation-based training, data-driven case studies, and interactive policy analysis

Language requirements
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. However, a strong command of French is considered a significant asset. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply
Applications should include:
• Cover letter, to be addressed to Serge Haan, Head of DHML
• CV, including any periods of absence from work such as family-related leave and career breaks
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications, projects, teaching expertise and accomplishments in knowledge transfer relevant to this role (1-3 pages)
• Statement of planned research, teaching and other activities at the University of Luxembourg (1–3 pages)
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught
• Names, contact information and current position of 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. Please indicate their relationship to you
We encourage early application. Applications are only accepted online through the HR system. The position will be unposted on 24th September 2026, after which no further applications can be submitted. Applications will be handled in strict confidence.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.
Diversity and gender equality
The University of Luxembourg embraces inclusion, diversity and gender equality as essential for academic excellence. We are fully committed to removing discriminatory barriers in recruitment and career progression and to advance gender balance among academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager*in

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real AG ist der Asset Manager der Commerzbank Gruppe und verfügt über 50 Jahre internationale Markterfahrung. Das Unternehmen vereint umfassendes Know-how im Asset Management mit breiter Strukturierungsexpertise und entwickelt daraus sachwertorientierte Fondsprodukte sowie maßgeschneiderte Investmentlösungen in den Bereichen Immobilien und Infrastruktur. Als Leasingdienstleister des Commerzbank-Konzerns bietet die Commerz Leasing zudem bedarfsgerechte Leasingkonzepte. Seit 2025 sind die Asset-Management-Beteiligungen der Commerzbank Gruppe bei der Commerz Real AG gebündelt. Neben den Marken und Produkten der Commerz Real zählen dazu die Aquila Capital Investmentgesellschaft mit Fokus auf nachhaltige Sachwertinvestments im Bereich Energieinfrastruktur sowie Yellowfin Asset Management als Boutique für liquide Investmentstrategien. Unter dem Dach der Commerz Real AG verwalten insgesamt rund 1.000 Mitarbeitende an rund 20 Standorten Vermögenswerte von rund 55 Milliarden Euro.

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
- Du übernimmst Coaching / Weiterbildungsaufgaben im Risikomanagement sowie die Ausbildung von Nachwuchskräften

Profil:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (auch berufsintegriertes) Studium mit der Fachrichtung Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise im Schwerpunkt Risikomanagement
- Langjährige fachbezogene Berufserfahrung im Bereich Risikomanagement eines Asset-Managers, eines Fondsemissionshauses oder eines Kreditinstitutes,
- Umfassende Kenntnisse und mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Assetklasse Infrastructure, idealerweise auch in Private Equity und Debt Strukturen. Grundkenntnisse und Interesse an den Assetklassen Renewable Energies, sowie Real Estate runden Deine Erfahrung ab.
- Erweiterte betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse insbesondere im Bereich Risikomanagement, Bilanzanalyse, Discounted Cash-Flow-Analyse, Sensitivitätsanalyse, Cash-Flow-Modellierung, Liquiditätsrisikomanagement und Portfoliosteuerung
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)
- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr sicherer Umgang mit MS Office
- Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise auch gute Französischkenntnisse
- Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Hohes Maß an Zielstrebigkeit und Eigeninitiative sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Flexibilität

title: Research Scientist in Mathematical and Physics based modeling of Generative AI (m/f)
description:
Research Scientist in Mathematical and Physics based modeling of Generative AI

(Valid from 08/09/2026 to 23/02/2027)

Language: English (UK)
Location: Luxembourg
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: SEDAN
Job Number: UOL08342
Contract Type: Permanent
Schedule Type: Full Time
Work Hours 40.0 Hours per Week
Expected Start Date: 01/08/2026

Expertise: Researcher / Postdoctorant
Job (internal): Research scientist
Functions: Researcher
Role Type: Open Position
Job Level: level 1
  
About the SnT

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.

The Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust (SnT) at the University of Luxembourg is a leading international research and innovation centre in secure, reliable and trustworthy ICT systems and services.
We play an instrumental role in Europe by fueling innovation through research partnerships with industry, boosting R&D investments leading to economic growth, and attracting highly qualified talent. We look for researchers from diverse academic backgrounds to contribute to our projects in areas such as: Network Security, Information Assurance, Model-driven Security, Cloud Computing, Cryptography, Satellite Systems, Vehicular Networks, and ICT Services & Applications.

The successful candidate will become a member of the Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust within the Interdisciplinary Research in SEDAN Team under the supervision of Prof. Dr. Radu State at the University of Luxembourg.

Your role:

• Support further developing and expanding the SEDAN team, its research, and role in shaping interdisciplinary research, in modeling of Generative AI
• Shape and supervise research direction at the intersection of AI and Mathematics, including Physics based paradigms
• Lead and contribute to the development and management of national and international projects in SEDAN, including proposal preparation, reporting, and coordination with external partners
• Foster collaborations across disciplines - in particular between Fintech and AI with private and public stakeholders in Luxembourg and abroad
• Contribute to teaching activities at the Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD levels in topics such as AI and machine learning
• Provide daily and content supervision of PhD candidates and support doctoral and postdoctoral training; e.g., research seminars, reading groups, workshops, and conferences
• Represent SnT and SEDAN in academic and public venues, strengthening the visibility of AI research in Luxembourg and abroad

Your profile:

• PhD in Physics, Mathematics or Computer Science
• At least five years of postdoctoral or equivalent experience in applied and fundamental research and technology transfer to the industry
• Research related to theoretical foundations of Generative AI
• Recent research experience with LLM, RAG systems, and/or agentic systems
• Proven experience with Ethical AI and EU AI act
• A strong recent publication record in top-tier AI conferences
• Proven experience in funding acquisition, project management, and coordination of national projects as well as industry collaboration
• Proven experience in teaching and supervising MSc, PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and management of small groups

Language requirements: The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer:

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply:

• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable
• Research statement and research plan for the next five years, including proposed research projects in the framework of the theme and mission of the profile

All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence. Applications by post or e-mail cannot be considered. Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception.

General information:

• Contract Type: Permanent
• Work Hours: Full Time 40.0 Hours per Week
• Location: Kirchberg Campus
• Internal Title: Research scientist
• Job Reference: UOL08342

Gender equality:

The University of Luxembourg embraces inclusion, diversity and gender equality as essential for academic excellence. We are fully committed to removing discriminatory barriers in recruitment and career progression and to advance gender balance among academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

title: Head of Property Management (h/f)
description:
Head of Property Management F/H

Reference: LU878379

Luxembourg
Permanent
Property and Real Estate

Notre client est un acteur reconnu du secteur immobilier au Luxembourg. Dans le cadre de sa croissance, nous recherchons pour son compte un(e) Head of Property Management afin de piloter la stratégie et le développement de son département Property Management.

Votre mission

Rattaché(e) à la Direction, vous définissez et pilotez la stratégie du département Property Management. Vous êtes garant(e) de la performance globale de l'activité, de la qualité des services délivrés aux clients, de la rentabilité du département et du développement du portefeuille sous gestion.
Véritable manager, vous encadrez et fédérez les équipes en charge des volets administratifs, comptables, techniques et opérationnels, en veillant à la cohérence et à la fluidité des actions menées au service des clients et des immeubles gérés.

Ce poste combine un fort volet management d'équipes, un rôle actif dans le développement commercial et la croissance du portefeuille immobilier, ainsi qu'une dimension stratégique auprès de la Direction.

Vos principales responsabilités

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie, les objectifs et les priorités du département Property Management.
• Piloter la performance opérationnelle et financière de l'activité au moyen d'indicateurs de suivi pertinents.
• Manager, accompagner et fédérer les équipes afin de garantir un haut niveau d'expertise, d'engagement et de qualité de service.
• Superviser l'ensemble du portefeuille immobilier sous gestion et assurer le respect des mandats, engagements contractuels et standards de qualité.
• Entretenir une relation de confiance avec les propriétaires, investisseurs et principaux clients.
• Superviser les dossiers complexes, sensibles ou présentant des enjeux financiers, juridiques, techniques ou réputationnels.
• Contribuer activement au développement commercial, au property development, aux appels d'offres et à l'intégration de nouveaux mandats afin d'accroître le portefeuille sous gestion.
• Garantir la rentabilité du département, le suivi budgétaire et la maîtrise des risques.
• Veiller à l'amélioration continue des processus, à l'harmonisation des pratiques et au respect des procédures internes.
• Piloter les projets de transformation digitale et favoriser l'adoption des nouveaux outils par les équipes.
• Intégrer les enjeux ESG, réglementaires et de conformité dans les pratiques de gestion.
• Assurer une communication régulière avec la Direction et favoriser les synergies avec les autres départements.

Votre profil

• Formation supérieure en immobilier, gestion, finance, droit, ingénierie ou domaine équivalent.
• Expérience confirmée dans le secteur immobilier et dans une fonction de management en Property Management, Property Development ou dans une activité comparable.
• Une connaissance du marché luxembourgeois est apprécié.
• Véritable expertise en management d'équipes, avec une expérience solide dans l'encadrement de collaborateurs, la gestion de clients institutionnels et de portefeuilles immobiliers complexes.
• Track record démontré en développement commercial.
• Leadership affirmé, forte orientation client et capacité à fédérer.
• Excellentes capacités d'organisation, d'analyse, de négociation et de communication.
• Esprit entrepreneurial, rigueur, sens des responsabilités et goût pour l'amélioration continue.
• Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais ; la connaissance de l'allemand et/ou du luxembourgeois constitue un atout.

title: Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director (m/f)
description:
Digital Factory - Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director
Location:  Luxembourg
Other locations:  Anywhere in Region
Salary: Competitive

Job description
Requisition ID:  1729702

Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Role Overview:

The Associate Director - Digital Solution Lead is accountable for leading a defined portfolio of digital projects for EY Luxembourg's Assurance Service Line. Acting as a program manager equivalent, the role translates Assurance priorities into an executable digital roadmap, governs demand and delivery across multiple squads, and ensures solutions are adopted, controlled, and delivering measurable value. The Digital Solution Lead partners with Assurance leadership, project teams, Digital Architects Team, to deliver high-impact digital capabilities with strong governance, financial discipline, and client-service focus.

Responsibilities:

• Own and manage a defined portfolio of Assurance digital projects from intake and prioritization through delivery, adoption, and benefits realization.
• Translate Assurance Service Line priorities into a practical digital roadmap, aligning portfolio choices with business value, regulatory expectations, user needs, and Digital Factory strategy.
• Lead demand intake, triage, business case shaping, and prioritization with Assurance Partners, Directors, Senior Managers, product owners, and operational stakeholders.
• Establish and run portfolio governance, including steering committee materials, decision logs, RAID management, dependency tracking, and clear escalation routes.
• Manage delivery plans, milestones, scope trade-offs, risks, issues, and interdependencies across multiple concurrent initiatives, intervening directly when delivery confidence is at risk.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across Assurance subject matter experts, business analysts, developers, data engineers, UI/UX, QA, change management, and enabling functions.
• Oversee portfolio budget, capacity planning, resource allocation, and financial tracking, ensuring transparency between planned investment, actual spend, and expected value.
• Ensure digital solutions meet business requirements and EY quality expectations, including data protection, cybersecurity, independence, auditability, risk management, and compliance considerations.
• Drive adoption with Assurance users through stakeholder engagement, communication, training readiness, feedback loops, release planning, and post-implementation support.
• Provide concise, executive-ready reporting to Assurance leadership and Digital Factory governance on progress, value, risks, decisions required, and portfolio health.
• Coach project managers, and delivery teams, building delivery discipline and a culture of accountability across the portfolio.
• Promote reuse, standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across Assurance digital assets, delivery practices, and operating model ways of working.

Expectations:

• Act as a trusted advisor to Assurance leadership, able to challenge priorities constructively and recommend pragmatic portfolio decisions.
• Operate with senior judgment, balancing strategic portfolio ownership with hands-on delivery support when projects require intervention.
• Influence effectively in a matrix environment, aligning senior stakeholders who may have different commercial, operational, technical, and risk perspectives.
• Represent the Digital Factory in Assurance forums with credibility, clarity, and a strong understanding of how digital delivery improves audit quality, efficiency, and user experience.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, Project Management, Finance, Audit, or a related field.
• Experience in digital transformation or software/product delivery or program management, ,
• Proven track record leading teams, engagements, budgets, dependencies, risks, and measurable business outcomes.
• Experience in Assurance, audit, professional services, financial services, or another regulated environment is strongly preferred; willingness to build Assurance domain depth quickly is essential.
• Command of Project Management and Agile delivery methods, with the ability to apply governance pragmatically rather than mechanically.
• Working knowledge of digital solution delivery, including data and analytics, workflow automation, AI-enabled capabilities, integration considerations, testing, release management, and support transition.
• Strong financial management, capacity planning, benefits tracking, and executive reporting capabilities.
• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and facilitation skills, with the ability to translate between business, operational, and technical audiences.
• People leadership experience, including coaching delivery contributors and building high-performing teams in a matrix organization.
• Fluent English is required.

Preferred Experience and Certifications:

• Recognized project, program, product, or agile certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, MSP, SAFe, Scrum Master, or Product Owner are an asset.
• Experience with delivery and collaboration platforms such as Azure DevOps, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, or equivalent enterprise tooling.
• Exposure to audit technology, data governance, automation, AI adoption, or digital operating model transformation in a professional services environment.

Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg

Join a team of diverse and dedicated problem solvers, connected by a common cause: to turn insight into opportunity for clients and communities around the world. If you are eager to learn, are interested in growing rapidly and strive to make an impact in a diverse environment, you're in the right place at the right time.

Learn more about Careers at KPMG Luxembourg
We are seeking a Staff Services Supervisor (m/f/d) to join our Facilities team.
As a Workplace Supervisor, you will play a key role in coordinating the team, overseeing daily operations and ensuring a consistently high level of employee and internal client satisfaction.

You will be responsible for:

•    Coordinating daily Staff Services operations and ensuring high-quality service delivery.
•    Planning and organizing work, including timelines, resource allocation and prioritization.
•    Managing and monitoring multiple activities and projects simultaneously, ensuring effective follow-up.
•    Supervising, coaching and supporting a team of junior staff members.
•    Organizing schedules, prioritizing workloads, delegating effectively and managing team capacity.
•    Acting as a primary point of contact for external service providers, overseeing contracts and managing attendance schedules.
•    Monitoring employee and internal client satisfaction, collecting feedback and coordinating appropriate actions.
•    Developing and contributing to high-quality internal concierge services and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
•    Strengthening the visibility of the team and developing effective relationships with other internal teams.
•    Ensuring service delivery, processes and deadlines are met in line with internal standards, service commitments and employee expectations.
What you will be working on

You will lead and support the continuous development of Staff Services, including:

•    Supervising daily operational activities and ensuring consistent service quality.
•    Leading, training and mentoring team members to deliver exceptional, hotel-grade service standards.
•    Managing team schedules, workloads and priorities to ensure efficient resource allocation.
•    Monitoring activities and preparing regular performance reports and KPIs.
•    Identifying operational gaps, analyzing root causes and proposing sustainable solutions.
•    Leading operational projects from needs identification and business case development through to provider engagement, process design, testing, deployment and change communication.
•    Identifying opportunities for process improvements, efficiency gains and operational innovation.
•    Developing and expanding concierge service offerings and identifying new value-adding services and partnerships.
•    Supporting the development of team members through regular feedback, coaching and individual development plans.
•    Fostering a motivating work environment that encourages initiative, continuous improvement and the sharing of best practices.

What we look for

•    A graduate-level qualification.
•    At least 3 years of professional experience in a similar position.

description:
Marketing & Communication Manager | SEB, Luxembourg

SEB is a leading international financial services group with a strong and well-established client base among both corporate and financial institutions. We consistently earn recognition for our expertise and customer centric approach, achievements made possible by truly listening to our clients, committing to quality and trust, and fostering an entrepreneurial mindset throughout the organization.  

SEB Luxembourg branch serves as the hub for Private Wealth Management & Family Office (PWM&FO) services to Nordic nationals living abroad. As part of the new strategy for PWM&FO we aim to become the leading wealth accumulator in our core markets and that requires a state-of-the-art core banking offering and financial infrastructure. It is also the base for many of SEB's funds and offers global custody and related depositary services to financial institutions.

SEB in Luxembourg has supported our home market clients with their international needs since 1973. Today the Branch has approximately 170 employees of over 25 different nationalities.

About the role

You will be part of a team, executing on an ambitious growth and transformation agenda. We foster an inclusive leadership culture built on empowerment and involvement to creating an environment where innovation can thrive.  
As the Marketing & Communication Manager for SEB AB Luxembourg Branch, your responsibilities stretch across borders, including PWM&FO in Luxembourg, Singapore, Norway, Finland and the United Kingdom, as well as our support offices in Nice and Switzerland. You will act as a strategic partner to the business, supporting growth and development by aligning marketing and communication activities with business objectives.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Overall responsibility for the coordination and implementation of the SEB Group Marketing and Communications approach in relation to corporate branding, visual and written identity. Daily tasks include maintenance and development of templates, internal awareness-raising and education activities, and providing advice on sponsoring and other branding matters.
• Maintaining close collaboration with the SEB Group Marketing and Communications department, other relevant stakeholders across the business division, and external parties.
• Responsible for production, distribution and record-keeping of marketing materials, including product sheets, sales material, newsletters, brochures, advertisements and event invitations, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and alignment with cross-border policies and standards.  
• Support the planning and coordination of events in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders, including the creation and distribution of invitations and follow-up activities.
• Responsible for external and internal communications, including production, distribution and record-keeping of client letters, newsletters, reports, statements, social media content and press materials. Support the bank`s employer branding, employee engagement and networking activities.
• Own & manage the banks of web and digital channels, including  creation, publication, and maintenance of content in internal and external platforms.
• Support the development of marketing and communication initiatives that strengthen the SEB brand and support business priorities.

To thrive in this role, we believe you have:

We believe you will bring a combination of marketing and communication expertise, strong project management capabilities, and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively, taking ownership of your responsibilities while maintaining a structured approach to delivering high-quality results.
You demonstrate integrity and professionalism in handling sensitive information, communicate effectively with wide range of stakeholders and can combine practical problem-solving skills with analytical thinking.

In addition, you have:

• At least 3 years of working experience, with proven track record of working with Marketing and / or Communication.
• A bachelor's or master's degree within Marketing or another relevant field
• Experience planning and coordinating marketing and communication initiative across multiple channels
• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite tools such as InDesign, Photoshop and Illustrator, combined with strong Microsoft Office skills
• Fluency in written and spoken English and Swedish, or other Scandinavian languages
• Knowledge of any of the three official languages in Luxembourg (French, German, Luxembourgish) is considered a strong advantage in dealing with local stakeholders, press and other external stakeholders.

What we offer

We offer many experiences and benefits to our employees, and there is nuance to every individual's career experience, but the elements that define the core of our offering are:

• Innovative company at the forefront of technology international opportunities and working environment
• Attractive compensation and access to SEB staff banking with exclusive benefits 
• A flat hierarchy and openness to share ideas, opinions and points of views
• Possibility to work from home part of the working time
• A diverse, inclusive and equal environment with focus on health & wellbeing

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.  
Learn more about working at SEB on our Career website or through our Career podcasts:
https://sebgroup.com/career & https://bit.ly/SEBcareer

title: Securities Lending Product Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Securities Lending Product Manager (f/m/d)

Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work

As a Senior Securities Lending Product Manager, you will play a leading role in shaping, developing, and commercializing Clearstream's securities lending and borrowing proposition within the broader Collateral, Lending & Liquidity Solutions (CLLS) franchise. The role combines strategic product leadership with practical product ownership across securities lending and borrowing, aligned with collateral management and liquidity, settlement efficiency, regulation, risk, digital transformation, and commercial growth.

You will drive the evolution of securities lending solutions for various clients' segments, ensuring the proposition remains competitive, scalable, risk-aware, operationally robust, and aligned with client demand, market structure, regulatory expectations, and digital capabilities. You will work closely with Trading, Sales and Relationship Management, Client Service, Collateral Management and Liquidity Products, Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and Pricing to translate market opportunities into deliverable product outcomes and resilient day-to-day operating models.

Your responsibilities

• Define, support and execute the strategic roadmap for securities lending and borrowing solutions, aligning product development with client needs, market trends, regulatory change, operational resilience, and the wider CLLS growth strategy.
• Identify opportunities across securities lending, funding and financing, balance-sheet optimization, and settlement efficiency, translating overlapping needs into scalable product capabilities and commercial solutions.
• Lead end-to-end product initiatives from concept and business case through design, governance, implementation, launch, operational readiness, post-launch performance review, and continuous enhancement.
• Develop clear product positioning, value propositions, pricing approaches, commercial proposals, and go-to-market materials that support client adoption and differentiate Clearstream in the securities finance market.
• Act as a senior subject matter expert on securities lending market structure, lender and borrower dynamics, collateral flows, settlement efficiency, and regulatory developments including SFTR, CSDR, T+1, and evolving capital and liquidity requirements.
• Translate regulatory and market changes, into practical product, operational, legal, and control requirements. Coordinate the alignment across Product, Legal, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and client-facing teams.
• Drive digital transformation across the securities lending proposition, including data-led decision-making, automation, workflow optimization, digital client channels, analytics, AI-enabled use cases, APIs, KPIs, and platform scalability.
• Use market data, client feedback, trading insights, operational metrics, incident trends, and performance analytics to identify opportunities for revenue growth, risk reduction, operational efficiency, and improved client experience.
• Maintain strong awareness of risk, credit, collateral eligibility, control frameworks, and operational dependencies to ensure the robustness of the securities lending proposition
• Represent Clearstream at industry conferences, client events, market forums, trade associations, and working groups, contributing to thought leadership and strengthening the firm's market presence.
• Prepare and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across Sales and Relationship management, Trading, Client Service, Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and Pricing to ensure successful product delivery, adoption, and operational sustainability.
• Mentor colleagues and contribute to a collaborative, commercially focused, risk-aware, and innovation-oriented product culture.

Your profile

• University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Financial Markets, or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant professional qualification is an advantage.
• 7+ years of experience in securities lending, securities finance, collateral management, market infrastructure, product management, or related capital markets activities.
• Good understanding of securities lending and borrowing, funding and financing market dynamics
• High awareness of the links between securities lending, collateral management, liquidity, funding, capital efficiency, risk, credit, control frameworks, and regulatory constraints in a financial market infrastructure environment.
• Proven track record of executing product strategy, building business cases, managing roadmaps, defining pricing approaches, and delivering complex cross-functional initiatives in regulated financial services.
• Ability to translate market and regulatory change into clear product impacts, operational requirements, legal documentation needs, control considerations, and implementation priorities.
• Commercial mindset with the ability to convert market intelligence, client feedback, trading insights, operational metrics, and industry developments into practical product enhancements and revenue opportunities.
• Strong digital and data orientation, with practical understanding of analytics, automation, workflow tools, dashboards, AI-enabled use cases, APIs, platform transformation, KPIs, and Agile delivery concepts.
• Experience engaging in industry forums, client events, working groups, conferences, or market associations,
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, build consensus across matrix teams, and drive clarity in complex, technical, or ambiguous situations.
• Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills,
• Fluency in English is essential; additional European languages are considered an advantage.

title: Junior National Funding Advisor – Innovation & Sustainability Grants (m/f/x)
description:
Fixed-term contract (CDD – 24 months), full-time, ref.: JNF09
Service: National Funding
Hierarchical Superior: Head of National Funding

About Luxinnovation
Luxinnovation is Luxembourg's national innovation agency. As a semi-public institution set up as an Economic Interest Group (GIE), we empower companies to innovate today to be ready for tomorrow. We also contribute to the development of the economy as a whole by identifying innovation opportunities and fostering collaborative innovation projects that stimulate the development of a sustainable, competitive and digital economy.
Luxinnovation is supported by three ministries — the Ministry of the Economy, the Ministry for Research and Higher Education, and the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs — as well as three semi-public institutions: the Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce, the Luxembourg Chamber of Skilled Crafts, and FEDIL – The Voice of Luxembourg's Industry.

Job mission
Department description
One of Luxinnovation's core activities is to support companies seeking national funding for their innovation activities and sustainability investments. The mission of the National Funding team is to guide and support companies throughout the process of applying for innovation and environmental state aid, ensuring they access the right instruments at the right time.
Job description
As a Junior National Funding Advisor, you will reinforce the National Funding team in the context of increased demand for innovation funding and decarbonisation grants. You will provide first-level guidance to companies, support eligibility assessments and contribute to the promotion of national funding opportunities — including the AI Factory initiative and environmental aid schemes.
You will progressively develop expertise across funding instruments, eligibility criteria and application processes under the mentorship of experienced advisors.

Main tasks and responsibilities
Your responsibilities are structured around Luxinnovation's four core pillars of activity:
Inspire:
• Contribute to the promotion of national funding opportunities by supporting the planning, coordination and delivery of awareness campaigns, workshops and events, particularly in relation to emerging environmental and AI aid schemes.
• Assist the National Funding team in knowledge-sharing activities and continuous improvement initiatives that contribute to the team's effectiveness and visibility.
Assess & Accelerate:
• Under the guidance of experienced advisors, participate in client meetings and support the preliminary assessment of companies seeking public funding for research, innovation and sustainability projects, including conducting eligibility checks and due diligence reviews.
• Support the review of funding applications by analysing project descriptions, financial statements, investment plans and supporting documentation, and contribute to the preparation of internal decision-support documents for Gate 1 and Gate 2 reviews.
Connect:
• Manage and qualify incoming client requests on a daily basis, with a particular focus on opportunities related to the AI Factory initiative and environmental/decarbonisation funding schemes, ensuring timely orientation towards relevant support services.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date information within the customer relationship management (CRM) system and other internal tools, ensuring high-quality data management and effective follow-up of client interactions.
Fund:
• Provide first-level guidance to companies on available state aid instruments for innovation and sustainability, including the AI Factory initiative and environmental/decarbonisation funding schemes.
• Collaborate closely with senior members of the National Funding team to address more complex client enquiries and progressively develop expertise across funding instruments, eligibility criteria and application processes.
• Contribute to the preparation of client feedback and internal decision-support documents under the supervision of senior advisors.
This list is not exhaustive. Additional tasks may be assigned to the holder of the job.

You will act as a key bridge between national/European initiatives and the Luxembourg business ecosystem, driving innovation and sustainable growth.

Required competencies
Education level and professional experience required:
• Holder of a master's degree (bac+5 in the French university system) in economics, finance, business management, engineering or a dual scientific/management profile.
• Previous internship or professional experience of 1 to 2 years in an activity related to innovation funding, business consulting, financial analysis or state aid.
Specific competencies:
• Good skills in financial analysis and the ability to assess investment plans and business documentation.
• Strong writing skills and the ability to produce clear summary notes and decision-support documents.
• General knowledge of project management principles.
• Ability to manage several complex files efficiently and independently.
• Relational ease allowing effective interaction with partners at relevant ministries, financial institutions and business managers.
• Organised, flexible, autonomous with excellent listening and analytical skills.
• Interest in innovation ecosystems, decarbonisation and sustainability funding.
Languages:
• Fluent French and English (oral and written) are mandatory. Luxembourgish and/or German are considered a strong asset.
IT skills:
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel in particular).
• Familiarity with CRM tools and internal data management platforms.

Why choose this position?
Join a human-sized, multidisciplinary organisation where you will learn to carry out eligibility assessments using solid procedures, tools and databases. You will be part of a team with a strong team spirit and a culture of information sharing, with direct exposure to Luxembourg's innovation ecosystem. This role offers diversified and rewarding missions — from analysing state aid applications to participating in events on cutting-edge technology — giving you the opportunity to build a solid foundation in innovation funding and public support instruments.

Application
Interested candidates are invited to submit online their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience and motivation for the role.
AI-generated applications might not be the best way to stand out. Show us the real you, and let's see where this journey takes us!
Please note that this position is based at our current offices in Esch-Belval. Luxinnovation GIE will relocate to the Luxembourg main station area in the first quarter of 2027.

title: Segment SOX Officer (m/f)
description:
Segment SOX Officer
Luxembourg
Trending
Job Description

The Segment SOX Officer plays a critical role within the SOX & Compliance team at Luxembourg, as he/she is

    Lead and manage independently the local SOX ITGC program for the defined scope aligning it with the requirements of the Global SOX program.
    Coordinate with ArcelorMittal Global IT Compliance Team / Global Assurance and the local IT Team for the SOX compliance program and be a focal point & take ownership for all SOX ITGC related issues and recommendations.
    Provide timely status reporting as required by Global IT Compliance/FPE SOX team, and periodic status reports to the local IT management.
    Identify/setup quick mitigation plans allowing to minimize/reduce Gaps
    Participate/supervise urgent SOX action/mitigation plans involving several teams (business and IT)
    Provide periodic management reporting allowing to give a synthetic view of the portfolio, issues and mitigations actions/plans
    Optimize the SOX IT General Controls and related processes; and provide consultation & advisory for various best practices on SOX ITGC related matters.
    Coordinate with the business for periodic risk assessments & scoping activities.
    Create and Maintain (with periodic review) of ITGC RCM, control descriptions and preparation of testing procedures aligning it with the global framework.
    Organize & Monitor the Internal SOX ITGC Testing – ToD, ToE & RF phases with the identified resources.
    Manage any Gaps raised internally including follow-ups for remediation & mitigation activities; and provide consultancy for remediation & mitigation efforts.
    Ensure the external SOX ITGC audits are planned, organized & coordinated with the relevant stakeholders, adhering to the group compliance calendar / requirements.
    Organize and manage necessary periodic meetings, status updates with the external audit team for SOX ITGC requirements to discuss and agree upon the audit results and findings.
    Manage any Gaps raised externally including follow-ups for remediation & mitigation activities; and provide consultancy for remediation & mitigation.
    Evaluate open deficiencies for ITGCs at year end for financial statement risk, perform risk assessments for any terminal gaps and manage them for a quick close-out.
    Maintenance of SOX ITGC GAP Summary report - Preparation, updating and follow-up, and ensure that remediation activities are done on a timely basis as per group guidelines.
    Provide all necessary advisories, participate in key project initiatives for identifying & managing related SOX requirements.
    Support control implementation for new controls coming from ITGC framework update / change of existing ITGCs for existing scope.



The Segment SOX Officer will be connected to all IT teams (based in India at the GCC or in Europe) and is reporting to Head of D&IT Finance & Compliance.


Minimum applicant attribute:



    8-10 years of relevant experience as IT auditor (including as internal auditor).
    Strong Knowledge of SAP Security & Authorizations (Knowledge of application / tool is a plus: SAP GRC or SAP IG or Pathlock or CSI AA, SailPoint ARM)
    Background in IT Engineering is a plus.
    Strong knowledge in ITGC/ITAC, GDPR.
    IT Project/change management in relation to SOX (e.g. deploy SOX to an existing app)
    Excellent understanding of IT applications, architecture and systems.
    Excellent communication skills and capability to synthetize, coordinate and report to C-level business people
    Assertive and ability to coordinate multi-cultural and multi-sites teams of different levels
    Excellent communication, negotiation, networking and listening skills.
    Strategic mindset and problem-solving skills.
    Analytical mindset and creativity to seek, encourage innovation.
    Strong customer-oriented mindset and real sense of emergency.

title: Buyer Rail Assets (m/f)
description:
Job Description

Assets & Strategic Projects Team

Within the European Procurement Organization Land Logistics (EPO LL), the Assets & Strategic Projects Team negotiates long term contracts for the private wagon and locomotive fleet of ArcelorMittal. We manage approximately 10 000 wagons, and we have 2 private carriers in Eastern Europe.

Our team is committed to excellence in every aspect of our operations. We believe in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member can contribute to our success.



Position Summary

This position will directly contribute to managing a part of this wagon portfolio and is based in Luxembourg.

If you are a motivated individual with a passion for procurement and a commitment to quality, we invite you to apply for the position of Buyer Rail Assets. Join our team and help us achieve our goals of providing added value our organization, reducing costs and being best in class.



Mission & responsibilities

    Identifying Needs: Work closely with various departments to understand their requirements and forecast future needs.
    Market Research: Conduct research to identify potential suppliers, evaluate their offerings, and compare them against organizational needs.
    Develop the procurement strategy for your portfolio based on TCO method (Total Cost of Ownership)
    Supplier Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers to ensure a reliable supply chain.
    Negotiation: Negotiate contracts, pricing, and terms with suppliers to secure the best possible deals for the organization.
    Monitor wagon contract, usage & cost date and coordinate with relevant teams to gather this data which will be used to ensure an optimal wagon fleet.
    Quality Assurance: Contribution to the Assets team inputs to the organization's quality standards and processes.
    Reporting: Prepare regular reports on purchasing activity, cost savings, and supplier performance.
    Follow-up of the contracts (KPI, contract review, improvement...)
    Compliance: Ensure all procurement activities comply with relevant regulations and organizational policies.



Working Conditions

The Buyer will work primarily in an office setting, with occasional visits to suppliers' facilities. The role may require travel to attend industry conferences, trade shows, and supplier meetings.



Requirements

    Education: Master level degree (Engineering preferred)
    Experience: Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a purchasing or procurement role. An experience in railway (in locomotive or wagons) is preferred
    Having a inclusive and collaborative team spirit
    Able to form good relationships with supplier and be able to manage key stakeholders.
    Able to prepare strategy, to establish partnership with key accounts.
    Skills:
        Excellent negotiation and communication skills.
        Self-driving and motivated
        Able to manage key stakeholders
        Strong analytical and decision-making abilities.
        Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
    Languages: Fluent English, French or German will be an added value.
    Valid Drivers licence.



Please submit your CV in English

In this role, you will be responsible for managing and supporting our modern IT environment across Microsoft 365/Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and virtualization platforms, ensuring the security, availability, scalability, and reliability of our systems. description:

Telecom R&D Engineer - NTN

With our groundbreaking satellite 5G constellation, OQ Technology is a global leader in IoT connectivity and next-generation satellite communication services. As a venture-backed company with a proven track record of satellite launches, we are the first in the world to integrate cellular 5G with satellites, enabling seamless connectivity for devices in remote and underserved regions. Our technology supports transformative applications across industries such as Oil & Gas, Maritime, Industry 4.0, and Transport, extending reliable connectivity through Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN). To support the continued development of our advanced telecommunications platform, we are looking for a Telecom R&D Engineer - NTN to join our team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and optimization of 3GPP-based protocol stacks and NTN adaptations for NB-IoT, LTE, and 5G NR technologies, helping bring cutting-edge satellite connectivity solutions from research to real-world deployment.

Key responsibilities

• Contribute to the research, development, and adaptation of L1/L2/L3 protocol stack components for Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) supporting NB-IoT, LTE, and 5G NR technologies.
• Participate in the full R&D lifecycle, including system design, implementation, integration, testing, and performance optimization.
• Analyze, troubleshoot, and enhance protocol stack behavior across multiple layers, including PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, and NAS.
• Investigate and implement NTN-specific adaptations required for satellite communications, including aspects related to propagation delay, Doppler effects, and timing synchronization.
• Design and execute testing and validation procedures, including unit testing, system integration testing, and performance benchmarking.
• Contribute to software integration and deployment workflows, including continuous integration and version control practices.
• Stay up to date with 3GPP standardization developments (e.g., NTN features in Releases 17/18/19) and contribute to translating standards into practical implementations.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including RF, FPGA, satellite systems, and platform engineering to integrate telecom stacks with hardware and system components.
• Support system-level analysis and debugging, including log analysis, KPI evaluation, and protocol trace inspection.

Basic qualifications

• An academic degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in telecom R&D, preferably working with 3GPP-based wireless systems.
• Solid understanding of 3GPP protocol architecture and procedures in NB-IoT, LTE, or 5G NR.
• Strong programming skills in C/C++, with additional scripting experience in Python for automation and analysis.
• Experience working in Linux/Unix environments with standard development and debugging tools.
• Familiarity with software development workflows, including version control (e.g., Git) and CI/CD practices. • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose complex system-level issues.
• Good communication and collaboration skills in a multidisciplinary engineering environment.
• Proficiency in spoken and written English.
• IMPORTANT: Candidate must already reside in Europe or hold a valid European residence permit.

Preferred skills and experience

• Hands-on experience with 3GPP wireless systems, particularly NB-IoT, LTE, or 5G NR implementations.
• Experience working with NTN architectures and protocol adaptations defined in 3GPP specifications.
• Practical experience analyzing and modifying protocol stack components across L1/L2/L3 layers (PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, NAS).
• Familiarity with core network signalling protocols, such as S1AP, NGAP, and GTP-C/U.
• Experience working with software-defined radio platforms (e.g., USRP) or open telecom stacks such as srsRAN and OpenAirInterface, or Open5GS and free5GC.
• Knowledge of O-RAN architecture and functional split concepts.
• Familiarity with Small Cell Forum (SCF) interfaces, including FAPI/nFAPI.
• Background in embedded or real-time software development, particularly on ARM-based or heterogeneous platforms.
• Experience with protocol debugging, KPI analysis, and system performance optimization in wireless communication systems.

title: Head of Strategy, Amazon Freight EU (m/f)
description:
Head of Strategy, Amazon Freight EU
Job ID: 10560220 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Leaders are owners. They think long term for our customers and don't sacrifice long-term value for short-term results. Amazon Freight Europe is looking for just such an owner to lead the strategy for our externalized freight business to design and deliver a world class freight experience for our business customers.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

The Head of Strategy will report directly into the leader of the Amazon Freight Europe business to lead and build out the newly created Strategy team across Europe (including UK). They will be based in Luxembourg, London or Munich to tackle the most hotly debated topics within our startup organization. They will partner closely with Product, Program, Operations and Commercial leaders to identify the challenges and opportunities in our organization, and come up with creative, customer-driven solutions to solve them. The Head of Strategy will work across both the European business and worldwide tech domains to shape our long-term business plan, diving deep with leaders across multiple areas to define customer problems and deliver the solutions.

ABOUT YOU

You're a self-described ‘builder' and ‘fixer' with a passion for figuring out what the future looks like. You have a relentless focus on creating and improving customer value. You're a hands-on multitasker who can quickly change focus and balance the needs of the moment with longer-term goals. You have a high tolerance for ambiguity and complexity. You have resilience and a positive, solutions-oriented attitude – even the toughest challenges are possible with the right amount of creativity, good judgment and hard work. You have strong problem solving, communication and organizational skills and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority, along with a good understanding of product development/management and digital media.

You're a leader with a blend of strategy, product management and/or operations experience and have the business acumen to understand and shape Amazon Freight's business-wide roadmap. You achieve your results through other people, often without authority, making complex decisions simple through data and inspire people at all levels in the organization. You proactively identify gaps and risks, and partner with senior leaders in and out of the organization to define creative solutions to solve them. You embody the rare combination of thinker and doer.

YOU WILL.

-Partner with Product, Program, Operations and Commercial teams to oversee strategic business initiatives from development through to successful execution, ensuring that individual function targets are in harmony and resolving those that aren't.
Support colleagues in their decision-making, program management, and initiative implementation, calling out opportunities to double-down and the unseen risks.
-Review, design, and execute improvements to organizational structure; find knowledge and skills gaps and help address them.
-Improve current processes and review organization-wide procedures for efficiency and productivity.
-Control the output of shared-services functions to ensure that outsourced tasks deliver to the high expectations of our Amazon Freight customers.

Key job responsibilities

•Ensure department goals are well integrated with each other and control organization-wide success, identifying areas to invest, double down or repair.
•Influence wider Amazon teams to secure collaborative, efficient solutions for our customers, re-using existing capabilities wherever possible.
•Build long term strategic plans, working alongside our product team, who specifies new products and features, our tech team that builds them, our operations that deliver them, our commercial team that sells them as well as the Amazon Freight teams outside EU.
•Stay close to the operational realities of our business, recognizing that what we will build has its foundation in the work of our Associates and partners on sites and in vehicles.
•This includes organizational design to help build our future team structures whilst securing support to our team for new hires, including documentation, onboarding, and learning and development team.
•Develop and build relationships with all employees for increased efficiency and responsiveness of existing operations, and help define new operational strategies by working with EU AF Director and other executives on special projects.

A day in the life

- Build relationships with our customers (shippers).
- Coach and mentor business developers within the team.
- Define business development KPIs targets and manage performance against these KPIs.
- Dive deep into shippers' requirements and pain points to find solutions.

About the team

At Amazon Freight, we blend advanced technology with Amazon's network of 6,500+ owned trailers and 13,000+ trusted carrier partners across UK & EU to move freight-simply and reliably. We apply the same customer obsession that we are known for in the consumer business to the Business to Business segment, aiming to partner with our customers to meet the demands of today while helping to navigate the road ahead. The team is diverse and intercultural with passionate members with a team-focused attitude. Across Amazon, we have committed to reach net-zero carbon by 2040, ten years ahead of the Paris Agreement and we take this commitment seriously in Amazon Freight too. We're not there yet but if this sounds interesting, maybe you can help us get there.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in team management
- Bachelor's degree or above
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Seven or more years of senior experience in a business management or operations management role.
- Experience in organizing and directing multiple teams and departments in a multi-matrixed environment.
- Experience in planning and leading strategic initiatives.
- Strong alignment with our leadership principles, particularly Customer Obsession, Think Big and Strive to be Earth's Best Employer.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Master's degree or above in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
- Experience coordinating between project teams and customers to meet unique customer requirements
- Experience in a high-performance start-up or incubation effort within a larger company
- Consulting experience, with a focus on operations management.

Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) regulations are rapidly changing how producers and retailers manage products and packaging after sale, including recycling obligations, fees, reporting, seller compliance, and reverse logistics. Amazon is building the technology and operating mechanisms required to manage these obligations at global scale while creating the foundation for broader circularity services.

This role requires a product leader who can operate in significant ambiguity, translate evolving regulatory and business requirements into durable technical solutions, and influence across a broad set of senior stakeholders. You will help determine where Amazon should build common global platforms versus localized solutions, establish mechanisms that improve accuracy and reduce manual effort, and shape new services that can support both compliance and circular-economy objectives.

Key job responsibilities

-Define and deliver AI-enabled products that scale global EPR compliance, including monitoring emerging regulations and policy changes, translating requirements into product and control strategies, and enabling rapid expansion across new geographies and regulatory use cases.

-Develop new circular-economy capabilities and services across recycling, recovery, reverse logistics, and producer accountability, identifying opportunities where Amazon can meet regulatory requirements while improving customer and Selling Partner experiences.
-Influence and align senior cross-functional leaders across engineering, science, finance, legal, public policy, operations, and sustainability to resolve ambiguous problems, make investment tradeoffs, and deliver durable global solutions.

description:

Description

At Amazon, safety is our top priority. We are looking for a WHS Risk Engineer to own machinery safety across multiple sites. In this role you will lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments, apply the EU Machinery Directive and harmonised standards, and influence engineering and operations leaders to build safe-by-design into our equipment and processes. You'll turn machinery-safety findings into consistent standards that protect our people across the network.

Key job responsibilities

- Lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments across multiple sites.
- Apply and interpret the EU Machinery Directive (2006/42/EC) and associated harmonised standards.
- Identify machinery and MHE risks and drive the implementation of effective control measures.
- Engage and influence functional leaders to build buy-in to Health & Safety standards and change.

A day in the life

You dig into how equipment and MHE is designed, installed and used, spot risks that others miss, and drive agreement on the control measures needed. The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) team plays a crucial role in keeping our people mentally and physically well at work. In this role, you will tackle difficult, loosely defined business problems across key retail programs including Selection and Vendor Management. • Improve code quality, optimize BI processes for speed, cost, and reliability, and mentor teammates

This is a high-visibility role where your analytical rigor and business acumen will directly influence how Amazon grows selection and manages vendor relationships across Europe. You'll work in an environment that values high-quality, well-documented solutions - and gives you the autonomy to deliver them.

Key job responsibilities

• Own the design, build, and maintenance of mid-to-large BI solutions - data models, ETL pipelines, dashboards, and analyses — supporting EU Stores retail programs such as Selection and Vendor Management
• Write advanced SQL and Python to solve difficult, loosely defined analytical problems and automate recurring BI processes
• Develop and maintain a deep understanding of data lineage: source systems, metrics aggregation logic, and how business intelligence is consumed and acted upon by stakeholders

title: Senior Product Manager, Regulatory Intelligence, Safety, and Compliance (RISC) (m/f)
description:
Senior Product Manager, Regulatory Intelligence, Safety, and Compliance (RISC) - Sustainability
Job ID: 10558293 | Amazon EU Sarl - A84

Description

Amazon is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the EU Digital Product Passport (DPP) product end-to-end. The DPP is a foundational regulatory obligation under the EU Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR) - and a significant strategic opportunity for Amazon. As product owner, you will define the vision and roadmap and translate a fast-moving regulatory landscape into concrete product requirements.
This is a builder role for someone who thrives in ambiguity. The problem space is not fully defined: regulations are still being finalized, harmonised technical standards are emerging, and Amazon's approach must be invented from first principles. You will set the goals, make the one-way and two-way door calls, and drive clarity across teams that have competing priorities. You will hold an honest tension between what the regulation requires and what creates durable value for customers and the business.

Success looks like: a defensible product strategy grounded in the regulation; a data pipeline and attribute framework that scale across product categories; on-time delivery of mandatory obligations; and DPP data positioned as a reusable asset that unlocks value across Amazon beyond pure compliance.

Key job responsibilities

* Own the DPP product vision, strategy, and roadmap.
* Translate regulation into product requirements.
* Shape the DPP data pipeline alongside engineering.
* Manage stakeholders and communicate with precision.
* Own DPP metrics and reporting.
* Extend DPP value beyond compliance.
* Operate AI-first. Encode product judgment, tenets, and trade-off frameworks into durable, machine-readable artifacts, and use AI to compress research, synthesis, and drafting cycles — owning the outcome and applying judgment to what ships.

About the team

The EU Digital Product Passport team sits within Amazon RISC International and owns Amazon's response to one of the most consequential product-compliance shifts in the EU. A Digital Product Passport is a structured, verifiable record of a product's attributes — origin, composition, sustainability, and circularity data - accessible via a data carrier such as a QR code. Under ESPR and its delegated acts, DPPs become mandatory on a rolling schedule by product category, starting with batteries and extending to textiles, toys, and beyond.
Beyond the regulatory mandate, the team is charting how DPP data can become a strategic asset across Amazon - for example, powering Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) eco-modulation, enriching the catalog, and serving as a single source of truth that auto-populates downstream compliance requirements. The person in this role helps define that ambition and turn it into a shippable roadmap.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
- Experience in technical product management, program management or engineering
- Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience with end to end product delivery

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
