description:
Head of Strategy, Amazon Freight EU
Job ID: 10560220 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Leaders are owners. They think long term for our customers and don't sacrifice long-term value for short-term results. Amazon Freight Europe is looking for just such an owner to lead the strategy for our externalized freight business to design and deliver a world class freight experience for our business customers.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

The Head of Strategy will report directly into the leader of the Amazon Freight Europe business to lead and build out the newly created Strategy team across Europe (including UK). They will be based in Luxembourg, London or Munich to tackle the most hotly debated topics within our startup organization. They will partner closely with Product, Program, Operations and Commercial leaders to identify the challenges and opportunities in our organization, and come up with creative, customer-driven solutions to solve them. The Head of Strategy will work across both the European business and worldwide tech domains to shape our long-term business plan, diving deep with leaders across multiple areas to define customer problems and deliver the solutions.

ABOUT YOU

You're a self-described ‘builder' and ‘fixer' with a passion for figuring out what the future looks like. You have a relentless focus on creating and improving customer value. You're a hands-on multitasker who can quickly change focus and balance the needs of the moment with longer-term goals. You have a high tolerance for ambiguity and complexity. You have resilience and a positive, solutions-oriented attitude – even the toughest challenges are possible with the right amount of creativity, good judgment and hard work. You have strong problem solving, communication and organizational skills and the ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority, along with a good understanding of product development/management and digital media.

You're a leader with a blend of strategy, product management and/or operations experience and have the business acumen to understand and shape Amazon Freight's business-wide roadmap. You achieve your results through other people, often without authority, making complex decisions simple through data and inspire people at all levels in the organization. You proactively identify gaps and risks, and partner with senior leaders in and out of the organization to define creative solutions to solve them. You embody the rare combination of thinker and doer.

YOU WILL.

-Partner with Product, Program, Operations and Commercial teams to oversee strategic business initiatives from development through to successful execution, ensuring that individual function targets are in harmony and resolving those that aren't.
Support colleagues in their decision-making, program management, and initiative implementation, calling out opportunities to double-down and the unseen risks.
-Review, design, and execute improvements to organizational structure; find knowledge and skills gaps and help address them.
-Improve current processes and review organization-wide procedures for efficiency and productivity.
-Control the output of shared-services functions to ensure that outsourced tasks deliver to the high expectations of our Amazon Freight customers.

Key job responsibilities

•Ensure department goals are well integrated with each other and control organization-wide success, identifying areas to invest, double down or repair.
•Influence wider Amazon teams to secure collaborative, efficient solutions for our customers, re-using existing capabilities wherever possible.
•Build long term strategic plans, working alongside our product team, who specifies new products and features, our tech team that builds them, our operations that deliver them, our commercial team that sells them as well as the Amazon Freight teams outside EU.
•Stay close to the operational realities of our business, recognizing that what we will build has its foundation in the work of our Associates and partners on sites and in vehicles.
•This includes organizational design to help build our future team structures whilst securing support to our team for new hires, including documentation, onboarding, and learning and development team.
•Develop and build relationships with all employees for increased efficiency and responsiveness of existing operations, and help define new operational strategies by working with EU AF Director and other executives on special projects.

A day in the life

- Build relationships with our customers (shippers).
- Coach and mentor business developers within the team.
- Define business development KPIs targets and manage performance against these KPIs.
- Dive deep into shippers' requirements and pain points to find solutions.

About the team

At Amazon Freight, we blend advanced technology with Amazon's network of 6,500+ owned trailers and 13,000+ trusted carrier partners across UK & EU to move freight-simply and reliably. We apply the same customer obsession that we are known for in the consumer business to the Business to Business segment, aiming to partner with our customers to meet the demands of today while helping to navigate the road ahead. The team is diverse and intercultural with passionate members with a team-focused attitude. Across Amazon, we have committed to reach net-zero carbon by 2040, ten years ahead of the Paris Agreement and we take this commitment seriously in Amazon Freight too. We're not there yet but if this sounds interesting, maybe you can help us get there.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in team management
- Bachelor's degree or above
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Seven or more years of senior experience in a business management or operations management role.
- Experience in organizing and directing multiple teams and departments in a multi-matrixed environment.
- Experience in planning and leading strategic initiatives.
- Strong alignment with our leadership principles, particularly Customer Obsession, Think Big and Strive to be Earth's Best Employer.

Description

At Amazon, safety is our top priority. We are looking for a WHS Risk Engineer to own machinery safety across multiple sites. In this role you will lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments, apply the EU Machinery Directive and harmonised standards, and influence engineering and operations leaders to build safe-by-design into our equipment and processes. You'll turn machinery-safety findings into consistent standards that protect our people across the network.

Key job responsibilities

- Lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments across multiple sites.
- Apply and interpret the EU Machinery Directive (2006/42/EC) and associated harmonised standards.
- Identify machinery and MHE risks and drive the implementation of effective control measures.
- Engage and influence functional leaders to build buy-in to Health & Safety standards and change.
- Use data and metrics to identify gaps and drive improvements across sites.

A day in the life

You work across several sites, moving between machinery inspections, risk assessments and working sessions with engineering and operations leaders. You dig into how equipment and MHE is designed, installed and used, spot risks that others miss, and drive agreement on the control measures needed. You use data to see patterns across sites and to prioritise where safety effort has the biggest impact. About the team

description:
Senior Product Manager, Regulatory Intelligence, Safety, and Compliance (RISC) - Sustainability
Job ID: 10558293 | Amazon EU Sarl - A84

Description

Amazon is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the EU Digital Product Passport (DPP) product end-to-end. The DPP is a foundational regulatory obligation under the EU Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR) - and a significant strategic opportunity for Amazon. As product owner, you will define the vision and roadmap and translate a fast-moving regulatory landscape into concrete product requirements.
This is a builder role for someone who thrives in ambiguity. The problem space is not fully defined: regulations are still being finalized, harmonised technical standards are emerging, and Amazon's approach must be invented from first principles. You will set the goals, make the one-way and two-way door calls, and drive clarity across teams that have competing priorities. You will hold an honest tension between what the regulation requires and what creates durable value for customers and the business.

Success looks like: a defensible product strategy grounded in the regulation; a data pipeline and attribute framework that scale across product categories; on-time delivery of mandatory obligations; and DPP data positioned as a reusable asset that unlocks value across Amazon beyond pure compliance.

Key job responsibilities

* Own the DPP product vision, strategy, and roadmap.
* Translate regulation into product requirements.
* Shape the DPP data pipeline alongside engineering.
* Manage stakeholders and communicate with precision.
* Own DPP metrics and reporting.
* Extend DPP value beyond compliance.
* Operate AI-first. Encode product judgment, tenets, and trade-off frameworks into durable, machine-readable artifacts, and use AI to compress research, synthesis, and drafting cycles — owning the outcome and applying judgment to what ships.

About the team

The EU Digital Product Passport team sits within Amazon RISC International and owns Amazon's response to one of the most consequential product-compliance shifts in the EU. A Digital Product Passport is a structured, verifiable record of a product's attributes — origin, composition, sustainability, and circularity data - accessible via a data carrier such as a QR code. Under ESPR and its delegated acts, DPPs become mandatory on a rolling schedule by product category, starting with batteries and extending to textiles, toys, and beyond.
Beyond the regulatory mandate, the team is charting how DPP data can become a strategic asset across Amazon - for example, powering Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) eco-modulation, enriching the catalog, and serving as a single source of truth that auto-populates downstream compliance requirements. The person in this role helps define that ambition and turn it into a shippable roadmap.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
- Experience in technical product management, program management or engineering
- Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience with end to end product delivery

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

title: Applied Scientist, SCOT FO Science and Tech (m/f)
description:
Applied Scientist, SCOT FO - SnT
Job ID: 10554093 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

How does Amazon decide which fulfillment center ships your order, which truck carries it, and how to keep promises across hundreds of millions of packages daily? How does it decide how many trucks and how much labor are required to ship orders across the network?

SCOT Fulfillment Optimization (FO) owns the optimization and forecasting science behind these decisions.

We are seeking Applied Scientists to join the FO Science & Tech team in Barcelona (alternatively: Luxembourg or London) with a strong academic background in optimization, machine learning, and/or time-series forecasting.

• You will design and build state-of-the-art machine learning and optimization models that power Amazon's fulfillment decisions at an unprecedented scale across two core scientific pillars:
• Large-Scale Optimization and Planning: Designing planning systems for order assignment and resource utilization, while balancing multi-objective cost-speed tradeoffs to enable controllers to steer millions of shipments per hour optimally.
• Demand Forecasting & Predictive ML: Developing time-series forecasts for customer demand, incorporating contextual information (weather, sales, order properties), and modeling uncertainty for core planning systems.

Basic qualifications

• PhD in Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience)
• Strong programming skills (Python preferred; experience with optimization solvers a plus)
• Research experience in one or more:
• Large-scale mathematical programming (LP, MIP, decomposition methods)
• Combinatorial optimization (assignment, scheduling, network flows)
• Multi-objective optimization and control
• Large-scale time-series forecasting (GenAI models, probabilistic forecasting, uncertainty quantification)
• Causal inference (spatiotemporal causal modeling, offline policy evaluation)

Preferred qualifications

• Experience building optimization systems that run in production at scale
• Being comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration cycles
• Publications in relevant venues

Key job responsibilities

Design and implement optimization and forecasting models for large-scale fulfillment problems, from order assignment to network flow control. Build research prototypes end-to-end: from problem formulation through scalable implementation to production validation. Analyse complex tradeoffs (cost, speed, capacity, accuracy) and translate findings into actionable recommendations for leadership and operations teams. Collaborate with engineers to bring science solutions into production systems serving millions of customer orders daily.

A day in the life

You formulate an optimization or forecasting problem on a whiteboard with teammates, then prototype it in Python with real data by the afternoon. You run experiments against production-scale datasets, iterate on the model, and present results to stakeholders who will use them to make network decisions next week. Some days you dive deep into solver performance; other days you're explaining a Pareto frontier to an operations leader. You collaborate with large engineering and product teams to bring your solutions into systems serving millions of customers. Alongside fast-turnaround prototypes, you own long-term research bets, the kind that reshape how Amazon's fulfillment network operates at scale. Your work goes live.

About the team

SCOT Fulfillment Optimization Science & Tech (FO SnT) is the applied research team behind Amazon's fulfillment decision-making systems. We decide how orders get assigned to warehouses, how capacity is allocated across the network, and how cost and speed tradeoffs are managed in real time, at global scale. Our models influence billions of euros in annual operational spend. They protect sites from overload during peak, reduce transportation costs and CO2 emissions, and ensure customers receive their packages when promised. Leadership relies on our science to make investment decisions worth hundreds of millions. We are practitioners of large-scale optimization: MIP formulations, decomposition methods, approximation algorithms, and parallelisation. We use machine learning where it sharpens our decisions, including forecasting, learned heuristics, and multi-armed bandits. We pick the right tool for the problem, not the fashionable one. You will work alongside Senior and Principal scientists, and collaborate with Amazon Scholars and academic partners who bring frontier research into our applied problems. We code our prototypes to be production-ready and collaborate with large engineering teams to ship systems, not papers. Above all, we have fun solving hard real-world problems at real-world speed, failing, learning, and shipping along the way.

Basic Qualifications

- PhD, or a Master's degree and experience in CS, CE, ML or related field
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in building models for business application
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience using Unix/Linux
- Experience in professional software development

About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
Within the FSTM, the Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (DHML) coordinates all teaching programmes in life in sciences, medicine, nursing, radiology and midwifery. The department's research combines basic and translational, molecular and computational approaches, with a particular focus on cancer biology, while also encompassing clinical research in human health and disease.
The DHML cooperates with the national health care centers and leading international biomedical research institutions. As medicine and health are strategic priorities for the University of Luxembourg, the department is actively expanding its education and research activities in these fields, providing exceptional opportunities for medical and biomedical initiatives.

Your role
The position focuses on innovative, interdisciplinary teaching in public health at the bachelor's level and within health-related specialization programmes. The recruited professor will establish teaching and expertise in areas such as epidemiology, health systems, disease prevention, and health policy.
The successful candidate will lead the development and coordination of public health teaching activities across the University's programmes in medicine, nursing sciences, and midwifery. The role includes the implementation of a state-of-the-art public health curriculum, incorporating advanced educational tools such as digital learning platforms, data-driven health simulations, case-based learning, and interactive policy analysis. Working closely with faculty members and clinical partners, the successful candidate will ensure an integrated and cohesive learning experience for students.

Research Portfolio
The candidate is expected to have an internationally recognised research profile and to bring a coherent research programme in public health. The candidate will develop and lead an ambitious research agenda in areas such as population health, primary care, prevention, health systems, epidemiology, health inequalities, data driven health sciences, and digital health.

Policy and Practice Integration
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in public health research and/or practice, with a commitment to integrating real-world perspectives into education. This will enhance the practical application of public health principles in healthcare and policy contexts. The possibility of maintaining collaborative activities with national health authorities or international organizations may be considered, depending on the candidate's profile and institutional partnerships.

For further information about the role, please contact: Serge Haan, Head of DHML, Email: serge.haan@uni.lu


Your profile
• MD/PhD or PhD in Public Health, Epidemiology, Health Systems, or a closely related field. An MD is considered an asset
• Extensive experience in public health research and/or practice, ideally with a strong track record in population health, primary care, health policy, or health systems analysis
• Substantial teaching experience in public health, epidemiology, or health sciences at undergraduate and/or postgraduate levels, preferably within medical, nursing, or life sciences programs
• Proven commitment to interdisciplinary and innovative teaching, particularly in integrating public health with medicine, life sciences, and nursing
• Demonstrated ability to design and implement new educational courses, including modules on health systems, epidemiology, and preventive strategies
• Familiarity with modern teaching methods and tools, such as online learning platforms, simulation-based training, data-driven case studies, and interactive policy analysis

Language requirements
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. However, a strong command of French is considered a significant asset. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply
Applications should include:
• Cover letter, to be addressed to Serge Haan, Head of DHML

• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications, projects, teaching expertise and accomplishments in knowledge transfer relevant to this role (1-3 pages)
• Statement of planned research, teaching and other activities at the University of Luxembourg (1–3 pages)
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught
• Names, contact information and current position of 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. Please indicate their relationship to you
We encourage early application. Applications are only accepted online through the HR system. The position will be unposted on 24th September 2026, after which no further applications can be submitted. Applications will be handled in strict confidence.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.
Diversity and gender equality
The University of Luxembourg embraces inclusion, diversity and gender equality as essential for academic excellence. We are fully committed to removing discriminatory barriers in recruitment and career progression and to advance gender balance among academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

Who we are

Luxembourg National Data Service (LNDS) is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg's strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation. LNDS enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner. The LNDS service portfolio includes know-how, capabilities, tools, infrastructure, and data services. Through efficient & responsible use of data and improving the secondary use of data, LNDS will support the acceleration of economic, ecological, and societal transitions.

Purpose of the job / project

HDAB-LU: This 4-year project, which started in January 2024, aims to develop and deploy the Health Data Access Body of Luxembourg, which is the national authority responsible for granting access to health data for secondary use as set out in The European Data Governance Act (DGA) and the European Health Data Space (EHDS). Its general objective is to enable Luxembourg to establish and deploy services for its HDAB, at minimum:
• processing and management of data access applications,
• supporting secure processing of health data by data users,
• making sure that they are well integrated in the EHDS,
• establishing and aligning with EU standards,
• and providing cross-border connections for large-scale deployment of HealthData@EU based on the work conducted by the joint action TEHDaS.

As an IT Infra Engineer II, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the company's infrastructure. You will work closely with the technology team to deliver high-quality services to the HDAB's end users, including data applicants and data users seeking access to health data for secondary use. In addition, you will monitor and report on performance quality metrics and support internal and external stakeholders, including national partners and EHDS/HealthData@EU counterparts, in resolving issues.

What you will do

• Help in the architecture, deployment, and improvement of cloud environments, as well as other IT infrastructures needed for the company to operate.
• Collaborate across teams to transform business needs focused on public sector data secondary use into secure and relevant deployments.
• Implement and ensure that the disaster recovery strategy is followed.
• Evaluate and deploy new technologies and tools to keep the infrastructure relevant.
• Assist to manage the Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions in place.
• Deploy, configure, and maintain servers, storage systems, and networking using different configuration management tools.
• Implement effective monitoring and logging solutions to proactively identify and address issues.
• Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including system configurations, architectural diagrams, and compliance reports.

Who you are

• Masters in a scientific, technological, or engineering discipline related to computer science, information technology, or computing.
• 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in designing, deploying, and maintaining complex infrastructure environments.
• Must have knowledge of automation for the cloud (e.g., Terraform) and configuration of resources (e.g., Ansible, puppet).

We participate in European project to support the secondary use of genomic data in the context of the European 1+ Million Genome (1+MG) initiative for an innovative and responsible ethical, legal and social implications (ELSI) framework. Our aim is to advise European policy makers in the implementation of a data infrastructure for secondary use of genomic data based on legal research, stakeholder interaction and translation of our findings into ethical, data protection and other legal norms into workable IT and policy solutions in the interest of society.

LNDS plays a key role in several projects linked to the 1+ Million Genomes (1+MG) Initiative.
As an ELSI Specialist, you will contribute to the privacy, ethical, legal, and regulatory dimensions of these strategic European initiatives.

title: Data Governance Officer (m/f)
description:
Data Governance Officer (M/F)

Luxembourg | req1168

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

As a Data Governance Officer, you will support the operational implementation of the Bank's Data Strategy and BCBS 239 programme. Reporting to the Senior Data Governance Officer, you will work with Business, Risk, Finance, Data and IT stakeholders to embed effective governance practices across the data lifecycle.

Your next challenge:

• Support the day-to-day implementation of the Bank's Data Governance framework, standards and procedures.
• Contribute to BCBS 239 implementation and related remediation activities.
• Maintain and control Data Governance artefacts, including the Business Glossary, Business Terms, metadata, data ownership and data lineage.
• Support Data Owners and Data Stewards in fulfilling their responsibilities and using Data Governance tools.
• Perform completeness and consistency checks on metadata and governance information, and coordinate the resolution of identified gaps.
• Support the documentation and maintenance of business and technical lineage across business concepts, data fields, applications and source systems.
• Embed Data Governance requirements in data and IT projects throughout the data lifecycle.
• Contribute to the improvement and automation of operational Data Governance processes and controls.
• Maintain evidence supporting BCBS 239, internal control, audit and regulatory requirements.
• Use Microsoft 365, Power BI, Copilot and relevant AI-enabled automation capabilities to improve efficiency and ways of working.

Your skills:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Economics, Engineering or a related field.
• One to three years of professional experience working with data, preferably in banking or financial services.
• Practical experience with financial, risk, accounting, regulatory or banking data is preferred.
• Previous Data Governance experience is an advantage but is not required.
• Fluent in English; French is an advantage.
• Good understanding of the data lifecycle, including data sourcing, transformation, storage, mapping and consumption.
• Knowledge of data development processes and the movement of data between systems.
• Working knowledge of data modelling, database and data architecture concepts.
• Ability to use SQL to explore datasets, analyse data structures and support data investigations.
• Knowledge of Data Governance and metadata tools, such as HOPEX, Collibra, Informatica, Microsoft Purview or equivalent solutions.
• Understanding of Business Glossary, metadata management, data ownership and data lineage concepts.
• Practical experience with Power BI, including data analysis and the creation or maintenance of dashboards.
• Strong command of Microsoft 365, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Teams and SharePoint.
• Practical knowledge of Microsoft Copilot and relevant AI-enabled productivity and automation capabilities.
• Knowledge of BCBS 239 or banking regulatory data requirements is an advantage.
• Highly self-driven, proactive and able to take ownership of assigned activities with limited supervision.
• Hands-on and comfortable working directly with data, tools and governance artefacts.
• Analytical, structured and attentive to detail.
• Strong team player who collaborates effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
• Able to challenge inconsistencies constructively, follow up with stakeholders and drive activities to completion.
• Curious about data, technology and AI, with a continuous improvement and automation mindset.
• Clear communicator who can explain data-related topics to different audiences.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

description:
ICT Risk & Governance Officer F/M

Luxembourg

We are currently working for a leading international professional services firm providing legal, governance, and corporate services to the financial services industry. The Luxembourg office advises investment funds, private equity firms, asset managers, financial institutions, multinational corporations, family offices, and high-net-worth individuals on complex cross-border transactions and regulatory matters.

In the context of a newly created position, we are looking for a ICT Risk & Governance Officer F/M. This candidate will be responsible for the implementation and oversight of the Company's outsourcing framework in accordance with CSSF Circular 22/806, and provides IT support in Luxembourg. The manager of this role will be the Managing Director of the Luxembourg Office.

The role is responsible for ensuring that all outsourcing arrangements, including ICT services provided by the Group Head Office, are effectively governed, monitored, and properly documented. In addition, the role provides local IT support to Company users, acting as the first point of contact for IT-related incidents and requests.

Key Responsibilities

1. Outsourcing Governance

• Support the deployment and continuous enhancement of the Company's outsourcing governance framework.
• Ensure outsourced activities remain aligned with applicable regulations, internal standards and governance requirements.
• Oversee the maintenance and accuracy of the outsourcing inventory.
• Manage and maintain outsourcing-related records, contractual agreements and service documentation.
• Liaise with key internal and external stakeholders involved in outsourcing activities.

2. Risk Assessment & Supplier Due Diligence

• Facilitate initial and ongoing risk evaluations of outsourced functions and services.
• Conduct or coordinate due diligence reviews on external providers and intra-group entities.

• Oversee ICT outsourcing arrangements, including services delivered by the Group Head Office.
• Monitor service quality through the review of performance reports, KPIs and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

• Gather and assess operational and performance data from outsourced service providers and intra-group entities.

• Produce regular management reports on outsourcing activities and provider performance.

5. Incident Management & Remediation

description:
Business Intelligence Engineer, SCOT Automated Inventory Management
Job ID: 10552964 | Amazon Europe Core SARL - LUX

Description

The Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization owns Amazon's global inventory management systems: we decide what, when, where, and how much we should buy to meet Amazon's business goals and to make our customers happy. We do this for millions of items, for hundreds of product lines worth billions of dollars of inventory world-wide. Our systems are built entirely in-house, and are on the cutting edge in automated large-scale business, inventory and supply chain planning and optimization systems. We foster new game-changing ideas, creating ever more intelligent and self-learning systems to maximize the efficiency of Amazon's inventory investment and placement decisions.

The Automated Inventory Management team within SCOT seeks an experienced and motivated Business Intelligence Engineer to develop analytical models and tools to automate the auditing of the SCOT systems. Such tools may include algorithms, metric bridges, dashboards, processes and workflow systems.

The successful candidate will have strong quantitative data mining and modeling skills and be comfortable working on new and sometimes ambiguous problems from concept through to execution. They will have strong communication and leadership skills, will be able to collaborate with other teams (e.g. software development, business owners, product managers) and to present findings to senior audiences to drive business improvements. As well we expect this candidate to raise the bar on any of the following categories: Data Warehousing, Data Architecture, Performant Self Service Toolsets and Data analytics. Candidate might be willing to work with the others BIEs in order to solve organizational problems at scale and setting the grounds of a healthy data products offer while delivering what is required by business.

Responsibilities may include:

- Performing complex analysis to understand the behavior of automated inventory management systems, identify the root cause of system / process issues and provide insight on potential solutions.
- Building audits (analytical products) to identify trend breaks or defects at scale for millions of products and multiple Marketplaces globally
- Assessing the end-to-end suite of audits and identifying opportunities for enhancements and simplification, working with other audit owners
- Creating new solutions to automate the business process of identifying and resolving defects (e.g. through metric dashboards and automated alarms, self service dashboard, Single source of truth tables... )
- Supporting the improvement of the automated audit workflow system: integrating new audits and providing input on the future developments/roadmap
- Developing dashboards and insight products
- Fostering culture of continuous engineering improvement through blueprints, mentoring, feedback, and metrics

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
- Experience with SQL
- Experience in the data/BI space

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
- Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

description:
Inventory Planner, AMXL Supply Chain
Job ID: 10518468 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Are you passionate about solving complex supply chain challenges that directly impact customer experience? Do you thrive in a role that combines analytical rigor with hands-on execution? Join Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) as an Inventory Planner where you'll define and lead placement initiatives that optimize our inventory network.

This role offers an exciting blend of analytics, execution, automation, and stakeholder management. You'll work on optimization exercises that improve how we position inventory across our network, ensuring customers receive their large items efficiently. Your work will directly influence operational performance and customer satisfaction, making a measurable impact across the entire customer journey.

Key job responsibilities

- Define and lead the execution of placement initiatives that optimize inventory positioning across the AMXL network
- Design and implement automation solutions to streamline inventory planning processes and improve operational efficiency

A day in the life

You'll start your day analyzing inventory performance metrics and identifying opportunities for optimization. You might spend time building automation tools to streamline repetitive processes, then shift to collaborating with operations partners on implementing a new placement strategy. Throughout the day, you'll tackle customer-facing challenges that require deep analysis, run optimization models to test different scenarios, and work with stakeholders to execute improvements that enhance the customer experience.

About the team

AMXL is Amazon's first true end-to-end organization for extra-large items, with visibility and impact across every mile of the customer journey. From the moment an order is placed to final delivery, our team orchestrates the complex logistics of getting bulky items to customers efficiently.

Our team culture thrives on knowledge sharing, mutual support, and continuous learning. We tackle unique challenges in the large-item space, innovating solutions that haven't been solved elsewhere. Location: Sliema, Malta

Employment type: Full-time

We are seeking a dynamic Country Manager to drive market expansion, build strategic client relationships, and accelerate revenue growth. This is an exciting opportunity to make a direct impact in a fast-paced, international environment.

Develop deep relationships with clients to ensure long-term partnerships and tailored solutions

Act as a product expert, confidently presenting current and upcoming offerings

Collaborate with internal teams to convert leads into successful client engagements

Create and maintain high-quality sales materials, including presentations and supporting resources

Develop commercially viable proposals aligned with both business and client objectives

Track and report on sales pipeline progress and customer journey stages

Represent the company at trade shows, industry events, and conferences

Deliver product demonstrations both remotely and in person

Partner with Product and Marketing teams to drive initiatives that support new business acquisition.

Fluent in Swedish or Danish, along with strong English communication skills, in both written and spoken communication

Strong network of C-level contacts within the gaming or gambling sector

Solid understanding of marketing principles

Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, complex, and evolving environment

Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines

Self-driven with the ability to work independently and collaboratively

Highly motivated with the ability to influence and inspire others

Hands-on, proactive approach with a strong sense of ownership

Excellent career progression opportunities within a fast-growing international organisation

Access to continuous learning and development through a dedicated learning platform.

title: Kundeservice søges til Malta - Betalt relokation
description:
Kundeservice søges til Malta – God løn, bonus og relocation-pakke

Kunne du tænke dig at kombinere en international karriere med livet på Malta?

Vi søger lige nu en dansktalende Kundeservice til en langsigtet stilling hos en international bank på Malta.

Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor du arbejder med danske kunder og får mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for kundeservice, salg og den finansielle sektor.

Stillingen er særligt interessant for dig, der allerede har erfaring med kundeservice eller salg – og måske har erfaring som Team Leader eller med KPI'er og dataanalyse.

OM JOBBET

Som Kundeservice bliver du en del af et team, der håndterer kundeservice, onboarding, salg og betalinger.

Du vil blandt andet:

• Besvare kundehenvendelser via telefon, live chat, email og SMS

• Hjælpe kunder med information om bankens produkter, services og betalinger

• Håndtere spørgsmål og henvendelser fra danske kunder

• Arbejde tæt sammen med betalings- og collectionsafdelingen

• Følge gældende procedurer, regler og lovgivning

• Arbejde med salg og aktivt identificere relevante salgsmuligheder

• Sikre en professionel og effektiv kundeoplevelse

Du refererer direkte til den danske Team Leader og bliver en del af et internationalt arbejdsmiljø.

HVORFOR MALTA?

Malta er en populær destination for danskere, der ønsker at kombinere arbejde med livet i udlandet.

Her får du mulighed for at bo på en middelhavsø med et internationalt miljø, gode strande, restauranter, et aktivt socialt liv og masser af muligheder for at opleve øen.

Virksomheden arrangerer blandt andet ugentlige Friday Drinks og forskellige sociale arrangementer, hvor du kan lære dine kollegaer og Malta bedre at kende.

HVAD FÅR DU?

✈️ Op til €1.000 i relocation-refusion til kandidater, der flytter til Malta

Refusionen kan blandt andet bruges til fly, taxi og dokumenterede udgifter i forbindelse med flytningen

God Løn

10% bonus udbetalt kvartalsvist

Mulighed for yderligere bonus efter 6 måneders ansættelse

️ 24 feriedage + 14 helligdage

Health & Life Insurance efter 6 måneders prøvetid

Gratis frugt, brød og morgenmadsprodukter på arbejdspladsen

Friday Drinks og andre sociale arrangementer

Gode muligheder for intern udvikling – både til andre afdelinger og management

Langsigtet kontrakt

HVEM ER DU?

Vi leder efter dig, der:

• Har gode engelskkundskaber både skriftligt og mundtligt

• Har erfaring fra kundeservice eller salg

• Er vant til at arbejde med KPI'er og data

• Er engageret, professionel og ansvarsbevidst

• Kan arbejde struktureret og følge procedurer

• Er god til at kommunikere med kunder og kollegaer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra kundeservice, salg eller den finansielle sektor, men det vigtigste er, at du er engageret, professionel og pålidelig.

PRAKTISK INFORMATION

Malta – Msida

Fuldtid

40 timer om ugen

Langsigtet kontrakt

1 dags oplæring

6 måneders prøvetid

Opfølgende reviews efter 1, 3 og 6 måneder

Hvis du gerne vil tage næste skridt i din karriere, samtidig med at du får mulighed for at bo og arbejde på Malta, er dette en spændende mulighed.

Der er en ledig stilling.

Ansøg allerede i dag.
Mathias@jobsqd.com

title: Quality Control Chemistry Analyst (Ref no: 449301)
description:
Job description  
To perform testing of finished goods according to specified procedures and in compliance to EU GMP
- To prepare, standardise and label stock solutions and laboratory reagents as required.
- To routinely monitor and analyse the water supply according to Company procedures.
- To ensure that all equipment, apparatus and premises of the QC Department are functional and suitable
for their intended use, by performing maintenance and calibration as instructed.  Apparatus should be
handled in the proper manner and not in a way which may be detrimental to its function.
- To assist outside contractors in performing calibrations throughout the company and keep records of
these according to standard procedures as required.
- To report LIRs and deviations in a timely manner.
- To work out calculations pertaining to analysis and produce the relevant documentation in association
always in compliance to EU GMP.  To ensure proper filing and easy retrieval of all documentation and
records pertaining to the QC Department.
- To assist the immediate superiors in problem solving exercises and other exercises aimed at improving
quality and efficiency.
- To perform laboratory equipment qualification and calibration accordingly to a predetermined schedule.
- To perform method validation as required.
- To maintain records of stocks of reagents, equipment spares and reference standards in such a way as
to report when re-ordering is due.
- To support the Technical Services personnel on laboratory investigations resulting from OOS, OOT and
OOE results and any deviations arising from the QC laboratory.
- To investigate and perform the prescribed hypothesis testing and analysis in conjunction with any quality
and root cause analysis investigations.  
- To follow and document (record) precisely all activities as described in the relevant Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs), Test Methods and Protocols.  
- To perform all duties as laid down and any additional duties as may be allocated from time to time by the
QC Manager or delegate in a proper professional manner and in the best interest of APL Swift Services
(Malta) Ltd.
- Executes product testing as per the approved methods of analysis.
- Inputs generated lab data in LIMS.

Requirements
- English language skills
- Diploma/ Degree in Chemistry or similar (Level 5 or above)

Training provided
Induction Training  
On the job training

Any assistance with accommodation/relocation
One time re allocation bonus to anyone reallocating from outside of Malta

Any other benefits
- Health Insurance
- Gym Benefits  
- Mobile and home plan internet benefits

Salary
19,500 - 25,000 EUR per year

How will the interviews be held  
Online

To apply
CVs and a covering email are to be sent by email to eures.recruitment.jobsplus@gov.mt and should be
written in English. Please quote the vacancy name and number (Ref no: 449301) in your email.

description:

title: IT Support Engineer
description:

Als IT Support Engineer ben je het eerste en tweede aanspreekpunt voor interne (en soms externe) gebruikers. Je biedt professionele ondersteuning en zorgt ervoor dat de operationele IT-processen vlekkeloos verlopen.

title: Medewerker meldkamer telecom!!
description:
Ben jij een gedreven probleemoplosser en klaar voor een nieuwe uitdaging waar je veel kan leren? Dan is deze rol als Servicedesk Medewerker NOC iets voor jou! Lees verder en ontdek wat deze uitdagende functie voor jou in petto heeft!

Als Servicedesk Medewerker ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor storingsmeldingen van bedrijven. Je werkt met geavanceerde monitoringsystemen om problemen op te sporen en op afstand op te lossen. Lukt dat niet, dan schakel je de 2e in. Ook stuur je vanuit kantoor de monteurs in het veld aan en ondersteun je hen waar nodig. Je dagelijkse taken op een rijtje:
Het aannemen en zelf opmerken van 1e lijns storingsmeldingen.
Het oplossen van storingen op afstand; indien nodig doorzetten naar 2e of 3e lijn.
Het aansturen en begeleiden van monteurs in het veld.
Werken in een 24/7 rooster na een uitgebreide inwerkperiode.

title: Medior System & Cloud Engineer
description:
Met welke techniek krijg je te maken?

Onder andere met Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, Hyper V, networking, VLANs, routing, switching, WiFi, firewalls, VPN, DNS, back up en recovery, endpoint security, EDR, monitoring, scripting en automatisering. We werken daarnaast met professionele MSP tooling voor monitoring, beheer, documentatie en automatisering.

Je hoeft echt niet alles al te beheersen. Sterker nog, iemand die beweert alles te weten over ICT vertrouwen we waarschijnlijk minder dan iemand die weet wat hij nog niet weet.

Wie zoeken we?

Je hebt ongeveer vier jaar of meer relevante ervaring in ICT beheer, systeembeheer, cloud engineering of een vergelijkbare functie.
Je kunt zelfstandig technische problemen analyseren en oplossen.
Je hebt goede kennis van Microsoft 365 en moderne Microsoft omgevingen.
Je begrijpt netwerken. IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs en routing zijn voor jou geen mysterieuze afkortingen.
Je hebt affiniteit met security.
Je kunt normaal met klanten communiceren. Ook met mensen die niet begrijpen wat DNS, MFA of een VLAN is.
Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je doet.
Je durft vragen te stellen en je mening te geven.
Je kunt zelfstandig werken zonder dat iemand continu over je schouder meekijkt.
En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent nieuwsgierig. Want ICT verandert continu en wij dus ook.

Wat verwachten we niet?

Dat je iedere technologie uit deze vacature uit je hoofd kent.
Dat je pakken draagt.
Dat je iedere minuut van je dag verantwoordt.
Dat je doet alsof je iets weet wanneer je het niet weet.
En ook niet dat werken het belangrijkste onderdeel van je leven moet zijn.
We willen gewoon goed werk leveren met mensen die hun vak leuk vinden.

Geen zin om de hele dag alleen maar tickets weg te klikken?

Mooi. Wij zoeken namelijk ook geen klassieke supportmedewerker. Bij RealNetwork zoeken we een ervaren ICTer die het vak leuk vindt en inmiddels genoeg kennis heeft opgebouwd om zelfstandig te werken, maar nog lang niet uitgeleerd is.

Iemand die een storing niet alleen oplost, maar zich ook afvraagt waarom die storing überhaupt kon ontstaan. Iemand die met een klant kan praten, een Microsoft 365 omgeving kan verbeteren, een firewall kan configureren en een netwerk kan ontwerpen. Maar die er ook geen probleem van maakt om bij een nieuwe installatie zelf een kabel te trekken of een access point op te hangen.

Kortom: iemand die ICT echt leuk vindt.

title: Medior asset management professional
description:
Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in assetmanagement, onderhoudsengineering of technisch projectmanagement
Aantoonbare ervaring met het zelfstandig uitvoeren van analyses, implementaties of verbetertrajecten
Je kunt verschillende perspectieven techniek, proces en organisatie, met elkaar verbinden
Je schakelt makkelijk met stakeholders, begeleid collega's en houdt overzicht in dynamische projecten
je werkt gestructureerd en weet hoe je resultaten borgt in systemen, processen en gedrag,
je kent methodieken als ISO 55001 LCC, FME(C)A of ITIL en weet deze toe te passen
afgeronde HBO of WO-opleiding
stevige persoonlijkheid met een scherp analytisch vermogen
klantgericht, professioneel en communiceert makkelijk met verchillende lagen in een organisatie

Werken bij Compris:
Bij Compris doen ze het net even anders. Er werken zo'n 45 bevlogen assetmanagement professionals die allemaal een zwak hebben voor techniek. Geen logge organisatie, maar korte lijnen, een betrokken directie en volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.
Je werkt hier in een omgeving waar inhoud telt, maar menselijkheid net zo belangrijk is. Samen met collega's die niet alleen energie krijgen van het helpen van klanten, maar ook van elkaar.
Wat je gaat doen:
Als medior consultant pak je zelfstandig assetmanagementtrajecten op van begin tot eind. Je combineert tactisch advies met gewoon doen, en juist daar maak je het verschil. Je werkt aan projecten zoals het inrichten van prestatiecontracten op luchthavens of het slimmer maken van onderhoudsprocessen in de industrie.
Je vertaalt strategie naar uitvoering en zorgt dat plannen ook echt landen. Of het nu gaat om het opzetten van programmeringsprocessen bij een waterbedrijf of het verbeteren van storingsregistratie en werkvoorbereiding in onderhoudssoftware, jij brengt structuur en overzicht.
Je schakelt makkelijk met verschillende stakeholders en weet belangen bij elkaar te brengen in een duidelijke aanpak. Thema's als risico gestuurd onderhoud, datagedreven werken en het vertalen van beleid naar concrete onderhoudsplannen? Daar draai jij je hand niet voor om.
En ondertussen help je ook collega's vooruit. Je begeleidt junior consultants en draagt actief bij aan het delen en borgen van kennis binnen Compris.

title: Servicetechnicus
description:

You set the squad's technical direction and write production code alongside your engineers. You also build the team, grow each person in it, and answer for how they perform.
C Teleport automates corporate travel for companies whose people are always on the move, with pragmatic engineering and machine learning doing the work that used to take a travel desk. Your squad is where that automation meets our customers' own systems. As Squad Lead you are the squad's face to the rest of the company. You work day to day with your Product Owner, who sits with you in Rotterdam, on what to build and how to ship it in increments. The main aim of this interdisciplinary project is to achieve minimal life based on chemical rather than biological components such as DNA, proteins or other macromolecules. Our PhD candidate will contribute by developing new microfluidic tools to work with micrometer-sized coacervate droplets, the compartments in which chemical replication, growth and evolution will take place.
What are you going to do?
The de-novo synthesis of life requires integrating the essential features of life, which include replication (the ability to copy oneself), metabolism (promoting the formation of one's own components from material in the environment) and compartmentalization (keeping the internal components together and separate from the environment) into a system that is maintained out of equilibrium. Key to the creation of a minimal form of life is Darwinian evolution of the resulting synthetic cell-like systems. Serving as the compartments in our work are coacervate microdroplets, consisting of a very dense aqueous phase containing a high concentration of macromolecules. title: Zorgcoördinator – Ernstig verstandelijke en meervoudige beperking
description:
Wij zoeken een ervaren zorgcoördinator voor de doelgroep ernstig verstandelijke en meervoudige beperking.

Wat ga je doen?

Je komt te werken in Clinge met de doelgroep ernstig verstandelijke en meervoudige beperking. Jouw toewijding als zorgcoördinator is bijzonder, jij biedt cliënten een fijn thuis, geborgenheid, structuur, stabiliteit en perspectief. Binnen deze doelgroep kan sprake zijn van moeilijk verstaanbaar gedrag. Dit vraagt om een sensitieve, geduldige en professionele benadering, waarbij je samen met het team en gedragsdeskundige zoekt naar de betekenis en behoeften achter het gedrag. Je begeleidt cliënten vanuit een individueel begeleidingsprogramma. Hierbij is het opbouwen en borgen van een onvoorwaardelijke ondersteuningsrelatie essentieel.

Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor de coördinatie en kwaliteit van zorg. In samenwerking met de manager en gedragsdeskundige zet je de lijnen van het behandelklimaat uit. Je stemt met alle betrokkenen af hoe jullie de zorg het beste laten aansluiten. Samen met het team en betrokken netwerk, heb je een coachende rol in het leven van deze cliënten. Dit doe je vanuit de Triple -C methodiek.

Je bent als zorgcoördinator teamcoach van het team, waarbij je het team coacht op zorginhoudelijke aspecten en de teamdynamiek. Daarnaast werk je wekelijks mee in het rooster, samen met je team. Met jouw enthousiasme breng je je kennis en ervaring over op je collega’s.

Naast je rol binnen het team ben je onderdeel van een zorgcoördinatorteam. Samen met je collega’s werk je aan kwalitatief goede zorg binnen Tragel. Je neemt actief deel aan de overleggen, denkt mee over ontwikkelingen binnen het cluster en bent een betrokken sparringpartner voor je collega’s in de dagelijkse praktijk.

Wat kun je?

De ideale zorgcoördinator werkt vanuit de visie en een positieve houding met minstens 3 jaar ervaring. Dit doe je met een grote mate van zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid voor de totstandkoming, actualisatie en uitvoering van bijvoorbeeld het zorgplan. Hiervoor heb je een relevante opleiding gevolgd en/of relevante werkervaring opgedaan.

Daarnaast ben je taak- en resultaatgericht en durf je voorop te lopen. Je hebt een goed beeld van zorgvragen en de mogelijkheden van de cliënten. Daar maak je concrete afspraken over. Je hebt een actieve rol in projecten vanuit maatschappelijke betrokkenheid, en je werkt zowel intern als extern samen met diverse disciplines en cliëntvertegenwoordigers.

Tot slot ben je goed in plannen, organiseren en doelgericht werken. Dit doe je met jouw goede communicatie- en sociale vaardigheden. Je bent in staat om op een inspirerende wijze collega’s aan te zetten tot kwaliteitsverbeteringen van zorg en begeleiding van de cliënten en bij te dragen aan ontwikkelingen in het team.

Een A1- of A2-opleiding, bachelor/graduaat orthopedagogiek, of opvoeder jeugd- en gehandicaptenzorg past perfect.

title: Flexi medewerker snijmachine
description:
Wil jij op dinsdag aan de slag als flexi medewerker bij een familiale aardappelboerderij? 
Je ondersteunt het productieproces aan de snijmachine en zorgt dat alles vlot verloopt. Je werkt actief mee en hebt een belangrijk aandeel in het maken van frietjes.

Jouw taken op een rijtje:

  • Je controleert de kwaliteit van de gesneden frietjes

  • Je bent betrouwbaar en stipt

  • Ervaring in productie is een pluspunt, geen vereiste
  • Je beschikt over minimum TSO werk- en denkniveau

title: Supervisor logistiek en maritiem | 2 ploegen| vast contract
description:
Ben jij een ervaren logistieke professional die het overzicht bewaart, snel schakelt en energie haalt uit een dynamische operationele omgeving? Heb je ervaring met het aansturen van teams en het coördineren van complexe logistieke en maritieme processen?
Dan is deze uitdaging binnen de logistieke en maritieme sector wellicht iets voor jou. Als Supervisor Logistiek & Maritiem ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse coördinatie van logistieke, maritieme en warehouseactiviteiten. Je zorgt ervoor dat alle werkzaamheden veilig, efficiënt en volgens planning verlopen. Daarnaast stuur je supervisors aan en fungeer je als belangrijke schakel tussen planning en uitvoering.
Jouw verantwoordelijkheden :
  • Mee opstellen, bewaken en optimaliseren van de planning van maritieme werkzaamheden.
  • Coördineren van logistieke activiteiten waarbij je continu afwegingen maakt tussen prioriteiten, capaciteit en de inzet van mensen en middelen.
  • Aansturen en coördineren van dagelijkse maritieme operaties.
  • Coördineren van werkzaamheden op een containerterminal.
  • Beheren en opvolgen van bulkopslaglocaties.
  • Waarborgen van een veilige, kwalitatieve en gestandaardiseerde uitvoering van operationele werkzaamheden.
  • Voorbereiden van werkzaamheden en opstellen van duidelijke transport- en werkinstructies.
Overdragen van werkzaamheden aan supervisors, inclusief instructies rond veiligheid, planning en doelstellingen.
  • Coachen, begeleiden en operationeel aansturen van supervisors.
  • Monitoren en bijsturen van externe partners en onderaannemers op kwaliteit, veiligheid, voortgang en KPI's.
MBO werk- en denkniveau.
Ervaring in een leidinggevende of coördinerende functie binnen logistiek, warehousing of de maritieme sector.
Ervaring met operationele planning en logistieke processen. Affiniteit met KPI-sturing en procesoptimalisatie.
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om verschillende stakeholders met elkaar te verbinden.
Goede beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels.

title: Begeleider in Oostburg(NL)
description:
Je gaat als Begeleider 3 of 4 aan de slag op de nieuwe woonlocatie Burghtkwartier in Oostburg op Groepswonen. Oostburg is een gemeente in het Nederlandse Zeeuws-Vlaanderen vlakbij de Belgische grens. Hier wonen en werken mensen met een ernstig verstandelijke beperking. De begeleidingsbehoefte is wisselend, omdat zij sociaal beperkt zelfstandig functioneren. Deelname aan het maatschappelijk leven is vaak met individuele begeleiding mogelijk. Met jouw begeleiding bied je structuur en ondersteun je bij een goed leven.

Tragel ondersteunt mensen met een verstandelijke beperking opdat zij een goed leven kunnen leiden in de samenleving. Onze cliënten hebben veelal langdurige en intensieve zorg nodig. Dit doen wij samen met alle betrokkenen met begeleiding, zorg, behandeling en verschillende mogelijkheden voor wonen, werk, activering en vrije tijd. Het gewone leven ervaren staat centraal, de behandelmethode Triple-C is hierin onze leidraad.

Ons motto ‘Samen doen’ heeft als doel de participatie aan de samenleving te vergroten. Tragel heeft ruim 90 woon- en dagbestedingslocaties in heel Zeeuws-Vlaanderen. Ruim 800 collega’s maken zich hard voor de zorg van mensen met een verstandelijke beperking.


Wat verwachten wij van jou?

  • Je bent enthousiast en levert een positieve bijdrage aan onze visie.
  • Je kunt goed zonder toezicht werken en bent betrouwbaar.
  • Je werkt bewonersgericht en bent praktisch ingesteld en weet van aanpakken.
  • Je bent collegiaal en hebt humor.
  • Onregelmatig werken is voor jou geen probleem. Je bent ook bereid slaapdiensten en weekenden te werken.


Je werkomgeving


Je werkt in een zelfstandig team op de nieuwe locatie Burghkwartier. Burghtkwartier is een woonlocatie midden in de samenleving van Oostburg. Deelname aan de maatschappij en participatie bieden voor de bewoners een meerwaarde.

Het betreft bewoners met een ernstige verstandelijke en lichamelijke beperking. De zorgvragen van de cliënten zijn uiteenlopend van overname van de totale lichamelijke verzorging en uitvoeren van verpleegtechnische handelingen tot meer begeleidende en ondersteunende vragen.

We werken met kernteams en stellen de bewoners centraal. Dit vanuit de visie van LACCS en Triple-C. Je werkt in een dienstenpatroon met wisselende diensten, zowel door de week als in het weekend. Indien nodig kun je ook op een andere locatie ingezet worden in Oostburg.

Een A1- of A2-opleiding, bachelor/graduaat orthopedagogiek of opvoeder in de jeugd- en gehandicaptenzorg past goed.

title: (Persoonlijk) begeleider - Waar zorg en gedrag samenkomen
description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor Stichting Wonen Plus een (Persoonlijk) begeleider - Waar zorg en gedrag samenkomen

Verplegen, verzorgen én omgaan met gedragsproblemen. Op onze locatie in Geleen-Zuid is het nooit óf óf. Altijd én én. En precies daarom solliciteer jij hier als (persoonlijk) begeleider. Omdat jij – hoe complex de doelgroep ook is – blijft kijken naar het totaalplaatje. Naar wat er wél kan. Naar hoe het slimmer, leuker of veiliger kan voor onze cliënten.

Zoek je structuur? Die krijg je ’s ochtends. Een beetje. En de rest van de dag? Dat is aan jou en je twintig collega’s. Met hen kijk je wat nodig is en wat kan. Dat kan even wennen zijn. Want zaken die op een andere plek strak zijn dichtgetimmerd, laten we hier heel bewust los. Omdat protocollen de cliënt soms eerder in de weg zitten dan helpen. Hier ren je dus niet achter andermans ideeën aan, maar achter de hulpvraag van de cliënt en jouw professionele kijk daarop. Voor veel van je collega’s voelde het alsof er een wereld voor hen openging toen ze zo konden gaan werken.

Ow en die eigen kijk van je? Dat is wat anders dan eigenwijsheid hè? We gaan er namelijk van uit dat je beseft dat je niet alles weet. En dat je de verschillen ín het team benut. Want sommige collega’s brengen sterke verpleegkundige kennis mee, andere zijn meer thuis in gedrag. Jij? Idealiter heb je van allebei iets in je rugzak. En het liefst ben je ook nog in staat om een brug te slaan tussen collega’s met die verschillende achtergronden. Vragen mag toch?

Dit ga je doen

· Dagelijkse praktische en psychosociale begeleiding van cliënten: structuur bieden, ondersteuning en activering. Geen behandeling.

· Omgaan met complex gedrag, zoals grensoverschrijdend of crisisgevoelig gedrag

· Uitvoeren van en bijdragen aan begeleidingsplannen

· Ondersteunen bij wonen, financiën, dagbesteding en sociale contacten

· Rapporteren in het cliëntdossier en resultaten zichtbaar maken

· Bijdragen aan een veilige omgeving voor cliënten, collega’s én jezelf

Dit ben jij

· Minimale opleiding is MBO-V of verzorgende IG, MZ niveau 3, MZ niveau 4

· Je hebt ervaring of affiniteit met mensen met complexe problematiek

· Je durft te werken zonder vangnet van strikte regels

· Je staat stevig in je schoenen en kunt samenwerken in een groot, divers team

· Je gelooft, net als wij, dat mensen meer zijn dan hun gedrag

· Je bent uiterst zorgvuldig in het signaleren van veranderingen in gedrag of stemming, bij de uitvoering van begeleidingsplannen en voor de dossiervoering
