title: Research associate: AI
employer: Stift The Stockholm Environment Institute, Sei
description:
The role combines hands-on evidence synthesis with the development and evaluation of AI-driven approaches to make evidence synthesis processes more efficient. You will work on manual evidence-synthesis tasks, while also using Python and/or R to build and validate machine learning, automation and AI-assisted workflows for searching, eligibility screening, and (meta)data extraction. Your work will also contribute to new meta-research on how, and under what conditions, automated and AI-based tools can speed up and improve evidence synthesis in the environmental field without compromising reliability, robustness or scientific quality.

Our team spans many disciplines and we welcome candidates from different backgrounds. If you have strong research and programming skills, want to help connect sustainability science with policymaking and are keen to learn evidence synthesis methods, we would like to hear from you.

Key tasks and responsibilities

Conduct and support manual literature searching, screening and (meta)data extraction for evidence synthesis projects, working with large volumes of scientific publications and grey literature (including bibliographic information and textual data).

Develop and maintain reproducible workflows in Python and/or R for screening, extraction, classification, quality-checking, cleaning and harmonization of textual and bibliographic data.

Apply and evaluate machine learning, natural language processing and LLM-based methods for text classification, information extraction and document analysis.

Validate automated and AI-generated outputs against human decisions, quantifying errors, uncertainty and potential biases.

Document methods, decisions and validation procedures to support transparent and reproducible research.

Work collaboratively with researchers across environmental, sustainability, climate, energy and social science.

Who you are

You are an early-career researcher with strong analytical and programming skills who enjoys working where sustainability research meets technology development – engaging with both the details of evidence synthesis and the computational methods that support it.

You are happy to do detailed manual eligibility screening and (meta) data extraction, while looking for opportunities to automate these processes and make them more efficient.

You have a background in, or strong interest in, sustainability or environmental research and enjoy learning from people with different disciplinary backgrounds.

You do not need to be an expert in every method or technology used in this role. We value someone who is curious, careful, quick to learn and a constructive team player.

The role would suit someone with:

    Programming and data analysis skills in Python and/or R, including version control with GitHub
    Experience handling large volumes of structured and unstructured text
    Practical experience applying machine learning, NLP or large language models to text classification, information extraction or eligibility screening
    An interest in evidence synthesis methodology
    Knowledge of, or interest in, sustainability or environmental research

Experience with more advanced AI development, such as model fine-tuning or deployment, is welcome but deep expertise in machine learning or software engineering is not required.

Experience with any of the following is highly desirable, but not required:

    Literature reviews, including systematic, scoping and rapid reviews
    Working with bibliographic datasets
    Literature eligibility screening or (meta)data extraction

Formal qualifications

    A master’s degree in data science, computer science, engineering, socio-environmental science, sustainability science or a related field.
    Early-career experience (1–2 years) in academic or applied research involving data analysis and AI/data-driven methods.

Personal skills

    Collaborative: comfortable working in teams and across disciplinary boundaries.
    Analytical and critical: able to assess evidence and critically evaluate AI-generated results.
    Systematic and data-oriented: enjoys turning complex information into reliable datasets.
    Clear communicator: able to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
    Curious and adaptable: interested in learning and applying rapidly developing AI methods.
    Quality-focused and responsible: attentive to research integrity, transparency, uncertainty and AI-related risks.

Additional information

You will join the International Climate Risk and Adaptation Team, which develops and applies pioneering research methods to define, describe, measure and communicate systemic climate risk in interdependent global systems. Drawing on diverse perspectives, its work spans quantitative and qualitative analysis, climate risk assessment, scenario and foresight development and AI-driven policy analysis.

Our offer

At SEI HQ we offer a stimulating position in an international environment. You will be part of a leading, multinational, multidisciplinary and multilingual team of experts in an organization where the well-being and development of our employees is of high priority. We value diversity and creativity at the core of what we do and we welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds to apply. Our ambition is to provide a safe, professional, and creative workspace for all.

An employment with SEI HQ includes:

    Collective Agreement incl. occupational pension and many other collectively agreed benefits
    An annual healthcare contribution and additional benefits connected to promoting our employees’ wellbeing such as yearly health check-ups
    Opportunities for professional growth and development
    Flexible working hours, 37.5-hour workweek and a generous amount of vacation days
    Being part of tackling environmental and development challenges and developing solutions for a sustainable future for all.

Once employed, you must live in Sweden, preferably in the Stockholm area. It is not possible to work from another country.

How to apply

We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis. Please submit your application as soon as possible, and no later than 26 October 2026, 23:59 Stockholm local time.

Applications must be written in English and submitted through our recruitment system. Please include:

    Cover letter highlighting relevant qualifications and experience (no more than two pages)
    Curriculum vitae (no more than four pages)

Please note that we screen all applicants manually. Incomplete applications will not be accepted.

You are an HSE role model with integrity and a strong moral compass, which is the fundament of the position. When everything works together

Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. title: Senior .NET Developer
description:
What will you do?

As a Senior .NET Developer who not only loves solving complex problems but is passionate about code quality, and building scalable and testable solutions.

You’ll be adequately self going, contribute to technical discussions, and aspire to deliver clean, robust code. You have a sharp eye for simplicity amidst complexity and pride yourself on thorough, thoughtful development, including writing tests for critical components. Whether working closely within your team or leading a project area independently, you’re confident, collaborative, and proactive.

Areas of ownership:

Requirements

    Exceptional and proven proficiency in the .NET area, including extensive experience with C#, .NET Core/5+, and related frameworks (e.g., ASP. NET Core, Entity Framework Core).
    Demonstrable architecting skills with a strong background in designing and implementing large-scale, distributed systems (e.g., microservices, event-driven architectures, serverless).
    Expert knowledge of design patterns, domain-driven design (DDD), and SOLID principles.
    Extensive experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and related services (e.g., managed databases, message queues, containerization).
    Deep understanding of various database technologies (SQL and NoSQL) and data modeling best practices for scalable applications.
    System-Level Thinking: Ability to decompose complex problems into manageable components and evaluate trade-offs between different technical solutions (e.g., speed vs. stability, buy vs. build).
    Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, driving consensus on critical architectural decisions.

Why Rebtel?

Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we’re profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. title: Cyber Defence Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced Cyber Defence Manager to take operational leadership of cyber defence and security operations in a complex enterprise environment.

In this role, you will lead and coordinate Security Operations (SOC), drive incident management and threat follow-up, and provide hands-on operational security guidance to technical teams and stakeholders.

You will play a key role in ensuring effective response to security incidents, including taking the lead during P1 and major security incidents when required. You will work closely with internal teams and external service providers, acting as a trusted Subject Matter Expert (SME) within cyber defence and security operations.

A central part of the assignment is to continuously improve operational security capabilities, with particular focus on reducing MTTR (Mean Time to Respond/Recover), strengthening security monitoring and detection coverage, and ensuring that incidents, threats, vulnerabilities and security risks are addressed in a timely and structured manner.

Key Responsibilities

    Lead and coordinate day-to-day Security Operations (SOC) activities.
    Drive security incident management and threat follow-up from detection through resolution.
    Lead P1 and major security incidents, including outside normal office hours when required.
    Provide operational security expertise, support and guidance to technical teams.
    Coordinate security activities across internal teams and external service providers.
    Ensure timely follow-up and remediation of incidents, threats and vulnerabilities.
    Track security risks, actions and improvement initiatives through to completion.
    Drive initiatives to improve MTTR and overall incident response effectiveness.
    Improve security monitoring, detection capabilities and coverage.
    Act as a Subject Matter Expert and support stakeholders in operational cyber security matters.

Required Experience & Skills

We are looking for someone with:

    Strong experience leading and coordinating Security Operations / SOC environments.
    Proven experience in security incident management and threat response.
    Experience leading P1, critical and major security incidents.
    Strong understanding of security monitoring, detection and incident response processes.
    Demonstrated experience improving MTTR and operational security performance.
    Experience identifying and closing gaps in monitoring and detection coverage.
    Ability to drive timely remediation and follow-up of security incidents, threats, vulnerabilities and risks.
    Experience coordinating multiple internal stakeholders and external security/service providers.
    Ability to provide pragmatic security guidance to technical and operational teams.
    Strong communication, coordination and stakeholder-management skills.
    Ability to take ownership and maintain structure and momentum during high-pressure security incidents.

About Soros Consulting

Soros Consulting works with qualified consultancy within IT, technology and business development. We match experienced specialists with assignments where their expertise creates clear results. Our focus is quality, long-termism and creating good conditions for both consultants and clients through clarity, professionalism and sustainable relationships.

Apply now.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager - CBRE, Data Centre Solutions

We are recruiting a Project Manager to join our specialist Data Centre Solutions team, located in Sweden - Stockholm - Rosersberg, reporting to the Oscar Fristedt Business Unit Head of Projects for Nordics

Job Purpose

To lead delivery of mechanical, electrical, fabric or construction projects varying in value, following the project management process from cradle to grave (meeting with the customer, developing a scope of works, putting together a tender and delivering the projects on site through to handover).


This role will involve one client. The role is managed on site together with already existing project manager and operations.

Role Summary:

The purpose of the role is to:


    Deliver projects from start to end.
    Ensure projects are secured and delivered on time and within the financial requirements and margins as specified by the business.
    Ensure that all projects adhere and are managed to commercial agreements / contracts. They must comply with statutory regulations, are QHSE compliant and meet technical industry standards.

General Activities:


    Ensure the safe delivery of projects through the management of risk and competence.
    Provide leadership in identifying and specifying project opportunities.
    Deliver contractual commitments on secured projects.
    Ensure projects are delivered on all maintenance contracts.
    Complete projects on time and on budget and to the satisfaction of all parties.
    Identify, reduce and manage all risks (technical, statutory, health and safety, commercial or otherwise) associated with each and every project.
    Maximise profit through cost reductions and better buying of subcontractor services.
    Identify and win project through effective relationships.
    Deliver supportive business communication through advice, review, leadership and direct contribution to management team meetings, briefings, consultation forums, correspondence, publicity, monthly and ad-hoc reporting and other applications as appropriate.
    Promote and maintain the core values of CBRE.

Business Development:


    Plan and develop long term opportunities by creating a pipeline of opportunities.
    Develop and manage all bids, tenders and proposals.
    Seek out opportunities to generate projects through innovation and different technologies

Building Relationships:


    Develop effective relationships with current and potential customers through demonstrating our capability in project delivery solutions.
    Build strong relationships with supply partners through which we can bring innovation to our customers.
    Ensure effective solutions which meet quality expectations can be delivered to our customers.
    Work with operational managers to ensure the collaborative development of the projects business with effective team working and support of colleagues.

Compliance:


    Make certain that their team comply with project management policies and procedures.
    Ensure compliance with health and safety policy across all activities. Regularly audit and review performance.
    Engage with supply partners in a manner that ensures all risk is appropriately apportioned.

Financial management:


    Development of project financial plans.
    Financial responsibility for the delivery of the annual projects plan.
    Produce monthly and ad hoc financial reports for the Head of Projects.
    Leverage margins on projects by working with subcontractors and suppliers to reduce project costs.
    Ensure positive cash flow.
    Chair monthly project reviews with BULs, PM's, Project Support, Finance Manager, Procurement Manager, Health & Safety Manager and Commercial Manager.

Experience Required:

Skills:


    Commercial awareness
    Financial acumen
    Influencing, selling and negotiation skills
    Understand commercial and financial metrics
    Internal customer management
    Networking skills

Knowledge:


    Knowledge of the construction market
    Project management methodology
    Broad understanding of construction Health and Safety law and legislation
    Understanding of general financial terminology.

Experience:


    Proven project management experience in either an M&E, FM, construction or critical environment
    Experience of developing new project opportunities
    Experience of creating, presenting and managing on bids, tenders and proposals.

Qualifications:


    Recognised technical qualification in either a construction, mechanical or electrical discipline.
    Business standard of written and verbal literacy as well as above average numeracy skills
    Recognised qualification in project management
    English and Swedish - writing and speaking.

Aptitude:


    Highly developed interpersonal and communication skills
    An excellent relationship builder
    Ability to inspire confidence
    Challenge status quo
    High degree of integrity
    Highly motivated and self-aware
    Highly organised with attention to detail
    Ability to network
    Results focused
    Innovative
    Handle high levels of information from a wide range of sources

title: Backend Developer
description:
If you’re looking to make the best co-op games in the world, you’ve come to the right place. We're proud to have some of the best game makers and collaborators in the industry working with us. What's more, we're a fun bunch of game developers, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together. Our games are not for everyone. Are they for you?

We are now looking for a Backend Developer

As a Backend Developer, you will play a key role in the design, development, and optimization of our backend systems. You will work closely with a collaborative team of developers and engineers, focusing on technologies such as C#, Microsoft Orleans, ASP.NET Core, Azure, and SQL Server. If you are passionate about building scalable and efficient backend solutions, we want to hear from you.

Who you are:

    

Proven experience in backend development using C# and ASP.NET Core.

    

Familiarity with Microsoft Orleans or other actor model frameworks for distributed and scalable systems.

    

Strong expertise in designing and optimizing database structures, preferably with SQL Server.

    

Experience with cloud technologies, particularly Azure.

    

Understanding of different backend architectural styles and best practices.

    

Not required but beneficial if you have experience with Kubernetes and frontend development

What you'll do:

    

Application Development: Design and develop backend solutions using C#, ASP.NET Core, and Microsoft Orleans, ensuring high performance, scalability, and maintainability.

    

Cloud Integration: Utilize Azure services to build and optimize cloud-based backend components, ensuring seamless integration with our applications.

    

Database Management: Design and implement efficient database structures using SQL Server, optimizing data storage, and retrieval for optimal system performance.

    

Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand requirements, provide technical insights, and ensure the successful delivery of projects.

    

Third-party platforms: Build, monitor and maintain integrations with third party platforms.

Our tech stack

    

NET/C#, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, Azure, SQL Server, CosmosDB, Redis, Grafana, Angular, TypeScript

How to apply

If you think that this position matches your background and skills, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV in English as soon as possible. We ask that your application always include relevant work samples or a link to your portfolio.

We interview candidates continuously and hire when we find a good fit.  

Practical Information

Scope: Full-time: 40 hours per week with initial 6 month probation period. Location: Office first, hybrid solution possible. You need to be eligible to work in Sweden.

We are a pet friendly office! You can expect to find dogs and occasionally some cats around.

What we offer

Arrowhead Game Studios is a growing team of about 100+ people, best known for our co-op titles. Despite our size, we remain a friendly and down to earth bunch, who love to indulge in our passion for video games together.

Located in a newly built, custom-tailored offices on the Hammarby Kaj waterfront, we enjoy everything Stockholm has to offer. A thriving game dev scene, along with all types of activities are immediately available on our doorstep.

Our talented developers are crucial to our success, therefore we put a lot of emphasis in creating and maintaining a prosperous culture. We’re committed to open and transparent communication. Your ideas are welcomed, valued, appreciated - the ceiling for creative discussions is high.

We also have numerous work benefits for all our employees. You can read about them here!

title: Senior Data Engineer - Software engineering background
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Data / Software Engineer who enjoys solving complex engineering problems and wants to work with modern cloud and data platforms for exciting clients across Stockholm

We’re looking for someone who can move comfortably between software engineering, data engineering, cloud architecture and distributed systems — designing solutions that are scalable, reliable and maintainable in real production environments.

What you'll work with

As a consultant at SwedQ, you'll work closely with engineering and product teams to design and build modern data-intensive systems. Depending on the assignment, that could mean building event-driven platforms, designing data architectures, developing backend services, improving large-scale data processing, or helping teams make better architectural decisions.

For this specific position, we are looking for someone with significant exposure to the Google Cloud platform and services such as:

    

BigQuery

    

Pub/Sub

    

Dataflow / Apache Beam

    

Dataproc / Spark

    

Cloud Storage

    

Cloud Run and GKE

    

Cloud SQL / Spanner

    

Vertex AI and the broader GCP data ecosystem

Beyond experience with individual cloud services, we value an understanding of the principles behind them and an interest in exploring different technologies and architectural approaches

That might include technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Spark, Kubernetes, Snowflake, Databticks, dbt, Airflow, terraform or equivalent services across cloud providers.

What we're looking for

You have a strong software engineering foundation and several years of experience building production systems.

You're comfortable discussing topics such as distributed systems, scalability, event-driven architectures, batch vs. streaming, data modelling, storage technologies, APIs, observability, reliability and cloud infrastructure.

You probably have strong experience with Python, Java, Go, Kotlin, Scala or another modern engineering language, and you're comfortable working with SQL when solving data-intensive problems.

As a consultant

Technical ability matters, but consulting requires more than writing good code.

You'll work directly with clients, understand their problems, challenge assumptions when necessary and turn ambiguous requirements into pragmatic technical solutions.

We therefore value people who:

    

Communicate technical concepts clearly

    

Enjoy collaborating with both engineers and stakeholders

    

Take ownership from problem to production

    

Are curious and continuously explore new technologies

    

Can balance technical excellence with business needs

    

Enjoy sharing knowledge and helping other engineers grow

Why join us?

At SwedQ, we’re an international team with people from different backgrounds, cultures and experiences — and we believe that makes us stronger, both as engineers and as a company.

We work with ambitious companies at the forefront of technology, giving you the opportunity to take on challenging projects, explore modern technologies and continue developing in the direction that interests you.

But work is only part of it. We genuinely enjoy spending time together — whether it’s after-work activities, trips, sports, dinners, gaming or just finding an excuse to have some fun as a team.

Most importantly, we listen to our consultants. We want to understand what motivates you, what you want to learn and where you want your career to go. Your interests and ambitions matter when we look at projects and opportunities.

We want SwedQ to be a place where you can grow professionally, work with great people and have a good time along the way.

title: Lead Project Leader - AWS AI
employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
description:
Job ID: 6456

Core Technology Change & Delivery is seeking an experienced AWS AI Lead Project Leader to drive the delivery and governance of Nordea’s AWS-based AI platform initiatives.

In this role, you will lead complex, cross-functional delivery across AWS cloud foundations, AI platform capabilities, security, data and engineering. You will help establish governed, scalable and reusable services that enable AI use cases across Nordea, while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security, regulatory and operational requirements.

You will translate strategic AI and cloud ambitions into executable plans, coordinate dependencies across multiple technology domains and provide clear, transparent reporting to senior stakeholders.

About our team

Core Technology Change & Delivery team is responsible for the Project & Programme management, the delivery & execution and governance of our Change Initiatives  to ensure we meet our commitments in adherence to our Core Tech Operating Model and according to Nordea Delivery Guide.

Main responsibilities in this role:

    Lead end-to-end delivery of AWS AI platform initiatives, from scope definition and planning through implementation, operational readiness and handover.
    Establish and maintain delivery plans covering milestones, dependencies, resources, financials, risks and expected outcomes.
    Coordinate delivery across cloud engineering, architecture, security, identity and access management, network, data, platform engineering and business teams.
    Drive the evolution of AWS cloud foundations required for scalable AI adoption, including landing-zone capabilities, deployment pipelines, runtime environments, connectivity and platform resilience.
    Enable reusable AWS AI services and platform components that support multiple AI use cases and teams across the organisation.
    Ensure alignment between business needs, AI use cases, platform capabilities, enterprise architecture and technology roadmaps.
    Facilitate governance and approval processes in line with internal policies, regulatory requirements and Nordea’s delivery framework.
    Establish clear decision-making forums, delivery standards, operating models and reporting practices.
    Proactively manage delivery risks, issues and cross-domain dependencies, escalating when required to maintain predictable execution.
    Drive operational readiness, including support models, service ownership, resilience, security, cost management and transition to operations.
    Engage senior stakeholders and provide concise, decision-oriented updates on delivery status, risks, financials and required actions.
    Promote a strong delivery culture based on ownership, transparency, collaboration and continuous improvement.

Who you are

Your background and skills include:

    Proven track record of leading complex technology programmes in AWS Cloud environments.
    Strong experience in AWS platform governance, cloud operating models, landing-zone implementation and platform evolution.
    Ability to scope, drive and govern AWS AI platform initiatives that provide reusable capabilities for scalable AI adoption.
    Experience leading delivery of AWS-native AI, machine learning and data services, with a clear understanding of how platform capabilities enable business use cases.
    Strong understanding of AI enablement platforms, including Generative AI, large language models, agentic or orchestration frameworks and model lifecycle management.
    Experience coordinating delivery across architecture, cloud engineering, security, identity and access management, network, data and platform teams.
    Ability to translate AI and AWS platform roadmaps into executable programmes, milestones and delivery plans.
    Strong understanding of platform-oriented delivery, including shared services, reusable components, automated onboarding and self-service capabilities.
    Experience establishing governance frameworks, delivery standards and operating models for large-scale cloud transformations.
    Understanding of cloud security, resilience, scalability, operational excellence and cost-management principles.
    Strong stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders, facilitate decisions and influence cross-functional teams.
    Very good financial, resource, risk and dependency-management skills.
    Very good analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to turn complex information into clear recommendations and actions.
    Advanced presentation and reporting skills, particularly using PowerPoint and Excel.
    Excellent communication skills and the ability to bring clarity in both written and verbal communication.
    Excellent English skills, both spoken and written.
    A proactive, pragmatic and solution-oriented attitude.

The role is specifically positioned around Nordea’s AWS AI platform rather than generic multi-cloud delivery. This is consistent with the planned AWS capabilities for enterprise-scale AI adoption and the current focus on a governed, scalable platform supporting AWS ecosystems.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

​Submit your application no later than 16/10/2026.

The recruitment process consists of the following steps:

    Preliminary CV selection
    Online interview with the hiring leader
    Background check

For union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

title: Marketing Manager B2B Telecom SaaS
description:
VX Fiber | Stockholm | Full-time

VX Fiber is looking for an experienced, hands-on Marketing Manager to take ownership of our marketing and help us generate more qualified sales opportunities across our international markets.

You will turn commercial priorities into a focused marketing plan—and deliver it. From sharpening our product messaging and creating campaigns to building HubSpot workflows and improving our website, you will combine sound marketing judgement with practical execution.

As our main marketing owner, you will work closely with sales, product, leadership, agencies and marketing specialists.

The role

This role suits someone who enjoys both deciding what needs to happen and making it happen. You can identify the right audiences, explain a complex technology offering clearly, and build campaigns that move potential customers from initial interest to a meaningful sales conversation, experirence in technology marketing and ideally B2B telecommunicaitons is highly valued.

You will have ownership of marketing planning, delivery and improvement, with the opportunity to shape how marketing develops at VX Fiber.

What you’ll do

    Own the marketing plan. Translate business and sales priorities into clear audiences, campaigns, budgets and measurable objectives. Make deliberate choices about where to focus time and resources.
    Generate qualified demand. Plan, build and improve campaigns across our website, email, LinkedIn and other relevant channels, taking responsibility for the content and execution.
    Work closely with sales. Agree target customers, qualification criteria and follow-up processes. Use feedback from sales conversations to improve targeting, messaging and lead quality.
    Lead product and solution messaging. Turn technical capabilities, customer insights and commercial benefits into clear positioning for network owners, service providers and other relevant buyers.
    Improve our website and content. Create and maintain product pages, campaign pages, customer stories and clear calls to action that help visitors understand our offer and take the next step.
    Equip sales with useful materials. Develop presentations, one-pagers, case studies and campaign assets that support customer conversations and help opportunities progress.
    Measure performance and act on it. Track conversion, lead quality, opportunities and marketing’s contribution to pipeline. Use the findings to improve campaigns and guide investment.
    Manage external support. Brief and coordinate agencies or freelancers, manage agreed budgets, and maintain quality and consistency across their work.

What you’ll bring

    Typically five or more years of relevant B2B marketing experience, with a track record of owning and delivering marketing activity.
    Evidence of generating qualified demand and supporting sales pipeline, with the ability to explain what you delivered and what changed as a result.
    Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a comparable marketing automation platform.
    Strong writing and editing skills, including the ability to turn complex technical information into clear, commercially relevant content.
    Practical experience with digital campaigns, website content, email marketing and LinkedIn.
    Confidence working with sales, product specialists and senior leadership, including challenging assumptions and recommending priorities.
    The judgement to balance ambition with available resources, and the willingness to produce work yourself.
    Fluent English. Swedish is a strong advantage, and additional languages are welcome.

Experience in B2B technology, telecoms, fibre, infrastructure, SaaS or connectivity would be particularly valuable. Familiarity with longer sales cycles, account-based marketing and managing external specialists would also be an advantage.

Why join VX Fiber?

You will have real ownership, close collaboration with colleagues across the business, and the opportunity to make a visible commercial contribution.

You’ll work in an international environment, helping customers understand technology that supports reliable connectivity and the development of digital infrastructure.

Practical details

    Employment: Permanent, full-time.
    Location: Based in Stockholm.
    Work eligibility: You must have the right to work in Sweden.
    Start date: As soon as possible, by agreement.

title: Postdoctor position available to study carbon assimilation in trees
description:
Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology

The Department of forest genetics and plant physiology is part of Umeå Plant Science Centre (UPSC, https://www.upsc.se/) which is a centre of excellence for experimental plant research and forest biotechnology in Northern Sweden. Our mission is to perform excellent and innovative basic research and generate knowledge that benefits forestry, agriculture, environment and society. We work across a wide range of disciplines in plant science reaching from cell biology to ecophysiology and from basic research to industrial applications. Our common goal is to understand the plants’ ability to grow, adapt and acclimate to a changing world and how we can breed better plants.

About the position

A post-doctoral position is available in the http://www.upsc.se/totte_niittyla at the Umeå Plant Science Center, Sweden to study carbon assimilation in trees using aspen as the model system. The position is part of a Swedish Research Council and NovoNordisk Synergy Projects. The latter is a collaboration between the Niittylä group, the https://cbmr.ku.dk/research/research-groups/moritz-group/?pure=en/persons/643429) at the University of Copenhagen and the https://www.helsinki.fi/en/researchgroups/plant-growth-dynamics at the University of Helsinki.

Trees represent the single most important carbon sink on the planet. An incomplete mechanistic understanding of carbon sequestration limits our ability of predict the capacity of trees to assimilate CO2 and optimise the production of sustainable wood derived materials and fuels. The project will adress this problem by investigating the connection between photosynthesis and downstream metabolic fluxes in leaves using a set of aspen mutants and isotope techniques.

The postdoc will collaborate between the three research groups, and will have the opportunity to pitch additional projects and integrate their own interests.

Your profile

Applicants should have a PhD in plant molecular biology, plant biochemistry or plant physiology. Biochemistry skills are important and previous experience on photosynthesis acclimation research in trees and Populus model systems are highly desirable.

English fluency and publication in peer-reviewed high-quality journal(s) is required.

As postdoctoral appointments are career-developing positions for junior researchers, we are primarily looking for candidates with a doctoral degree that is three years old at most.

About us

UPSC belongs to two universities, the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences and Umeå University. About 200 people from more than 40 different nationalities work here. We host some 30 principal investigators, and our researchers have access to state-of-the-art analytical platforms, unique tree germplasm resources and plant growth facilities. We strive for a collaborative work environment and support our scientists throughout all career stages by providing professional training opportunities and individual career mentoring.

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

Location:

Form of employment:

Temporary employment 24 months, with the possibility of extension depending on funding and project progress.

Scope:

100%

January 2027 or as agreed.

Application:

The application should include a letter of interest detailing research experience, achievements and publications and curriculum vitae.

Please submit your application before deadline 21 October 2026. You can submit your application by clicking the button below.

The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. title: Office Manager and Data Annotator
description:
About Univrses

Univrses is a Stockholm-based 3D Computer Vision and AI company. We provide the perception and spatial awareness necessary for an increasingly autonomous world. While our roots are in the automotive sector, we have pioneered a new category: Infrastructure Intelligence. Our 3DAI™ system transforms ordinary vehicles into sophisticated mobile sensors, providing road authorities across Europe (Sweden, UK, Italy, and beyond) with real-time, actionable insights. We are shifting city management from reactive repairs to proactive, data-driven maintenance—saving costs, reducing CO2 emissions, and improving public safety.

The Mission

    

The Backbone of Operations: Every 3DAI™ deployment starts with a phone and a holder in a box. You make sure devices are set up, tested and shipped across Europe on time and fully traceable.

    

Quality at the Source: Our AI is only as good as its data. You help keep our annotation work accurate and on schedule.

    

The Heart of the Office: You shape the everyday experience of 40 scientists, engineers and business builders in our bright office by the water in Hammarby Sjöstad.

    

Established yet Agile: Founded in 2015, we have the stability of an established firm with the speed of a startup.

The Role

A hands-on, varied role spanning data, hardware, logistics and workplace. No two days look the same, and you'll be the go-to person who makes things happen.

    

Data Annotation & Quality: Annotate, re-annotate and validate data, monitor quality standards, and troubleshoot annotation tools.

    

Annotation Team Support: Help annotators meet productivity, quality and deadline targets. Train new annotators and answer questions about processes and tools.

    

Device Setup: Charge, configure and install apps on phones and car phone holders, create user accounts per internal guidelines, and test every device before it ships.

    

Packaging & Shipping: Pack collection kits according to checklists, label and document contents, ship via our providers, and log tracking so all hardware is traceable.

    

Inventory Management: Keep device and accessory inventory up to date, run regular stock checks, and initiate replenishment when stock runs low.

    

Office Coordination: Organise weekly team breakfast and Lunch & Learns (polls, food orders and all), manage office hardware, and handle deliveries, including pickups from local collection points.

    

Workplace Environment: Keep the office tidy and welcoming, from desks and fridges to fresh flowers, and proactively improve how we work.

Who You Are

    

Organised by Nature: You love structure, checklists and accurate records.

    

Hands-on and Practical: You're comfortable unboxing deliveries, setting up a phone, packing a shipment and fixing a basic tech issue, all in the same afternoon.

    

Detail-oriented: Whether validating annotations or labelling a package, you get it right the first time.

    

Service-minded: You enjoy helping colleagues and making the workplace better for everyone.

What You Bring

Required:

    

Experience: Background in office coordination, administration, operations, logistics or a similar hands-on role.

    

Tech Comfort: Confident setting up smartphones and apps and quick to learn new tools.

    

Accuracy: A track record of maintaining precise records, inventories or quality-controlled work.

    

Communication: Fluent English, with the ability to explain processes clearly and train others.

Preferred:

    

Experience with data annotation, labelling or quality assurance work.

    

Experience with inventory management, shipping or e-commerce logistics.

    

Swedish language skills.

    

AI-tool literacy — using AI to speed up your own workflows and problem-solving.

    

Driving licence.

What's in It for You?

We provide the environment and the tools for you to do the best work of your career.

    

Responsibility: Become a true stakeholder in a small team where your work keeps our operations running.

    

Variety and Growth: Gain exposure to AI data workflows, hardware deployment and international logistics, with real room to shape how we work.

    

The "Work-Life" Blend: A culture that values output over "desk time". Overtime is rare, something you don't find in many tech startups.

    

Upsides: A secure Pension Plan and Wellness activities for up to 5 000 SEK per year paid by the company.

The Univrses Culture:

    

Monday Momentum: Kick off the week with team breakfast.

    

Thursday Knowledge: Weekly Lunch & Learns with internal or external speakers, with catered lunch paid by the company.

    

Friday Wind-down: Celebrate the week's wins at Friday After Work (free beer from our well-curated beer fridge!).

    

The Workspace: A bright, collaborative office in Stockholm with the essentials (yes, including the mandatory startup ping-pong table).

Are You Our Next Office Manager and Data Annotator?

If you're an organised, hands-on problem solver who loves keeping things running smoothly, we want to hear from you.

To apply, please include the following:

    

Your CV

    

A cover letter

Note: All application materials must be in English.

title: Doctoral student (Licentiate) in machine learning
description:
Halmstad University

Work at a University where different perspectives meet!

Halmstad University adds value, drives innovation and prepares people and society for the future. Since the beginning in 1983, innovation and collaboration with society have characterised the University's education and research. The research is internationally reputable and is largely conducted in a multidisciplinary manner within the University's two focus areas: Health Innovation and Smart Cities and Communities. The University has a wide range of education with many popular study programmes. The campus is modern and well-equipped, and is situated close to both public transportation and the city center.

More information about working at Halmstad University

The School of Information Technology

Halmstad University’s School of Information Technology (ITE) is a renowned multi-disciplinary institution with around 155 employees from 20 different countries. ITE is internationally recognised for its applied research and collaborative initiatives, focusing on smart technology and its practical applications.

Within ITE, our students and researchers engage in diverse areas of study, including electronics, AI, information-driven healthcare, autonomous vehicles, social robotics, and digital design. We offer a comprehensive range of educational programmes, ranging from undergraduate to doctoral levels, as well as professional development opportunities.

Research is conducted within the University’s research programmes, especially Information Driven Care (IDC), Re-Imagining Future Smart Living – beyond the Living Lab (REBEL), Learning in a Digitalised Society (LeaDS) and the Future Industry Research Programme (FIRP).

ITE is home to Leap for Life, an innovation centre for information-driven care, as well as the Electronics Centre in Halmstad (ECH), a collaborative space for electronic development.

More information about the School of Information Technology

Description

The information-driven care research program has a continued need to strengthen doctoral-level research on AI and ML in healthcare, encompassing main research projects such as CAISR Health, a KK Foundation-funded research profile on responsible and trustworthy AI/ML in healthcare, and Informationsdriven nära vård, which analyses the full patient care chain and trajectory to identify how AI, ML and information-driven approaches can provide more insights to improve care. The program needs a doctoral student to conduct research towards a licentiate degree within this area, contributing new methods and insights within the triple-helix collaboration between academia, regions, municipalities, and industry partners. Tasks include:

- Conduct doctoral-level research towards a licentiate degree within the information-driven care research program, focusing on one or more of the following research areas: Representation learning, Vertical federated learning, Time-series analysis and modelling, Uncertainty quantification, Multimodal / heterogeneous data fusion, Sequential and trajectory modelling, Graph-based learning, Explainable and interpretable AI, Causal inference, Privacy-preserving machine learning

- Publish research findings in peer-reviewed scientific venues

- Complete relevant doctoral coursework as part of the licentiate programme

- Participate actively in the information-driven care research program's activities and in collaboration with regions, municipalities, and industry partners within the triple-helix model

- Teaching and supervision duties (up to 20%) can be included

This is a position to a licentiate degree. Subject to securing additional funding, there may be a possibility to extend the position and continue towards a full PhD after the licentiate degree.

Qualifications

Only those who are or have been admitted to third-cycle courses and study programs at a higher education may be appointed to doctoral studentships. (The Higher Education Ordinance Chapter 5 Section 3). The student’s ability to benefit from doctoral studies will be taken into account when we make the appointment. - Experience in one or more related areas such as multimodal data fusion, sequential and trajectory modelling, graph-based learning, explainable AI, causal inference, or privacy-preserving machine learning is required.

Doctoral students are employees of the University and paid a salary according to a uniform salary scale, adjusted in relation to the progress in education.

title: Postdoc position in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
description:
Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.

The Robotics and Artificial Intelligence group at Luleå University of Technology works in field robotics and tests its methods on robots in real environments. We are now looking for a postdoctoral researcher to develop sensing and autonomy for drones that inspect infrastructure and terrain in Arctic environments such as Greenland, where the flights take place in severe cold. You will work on sensor systems that withstand the arctic cold and, on the localisation, mapping and mission planning methods that depend on them. We value good collaboration skills and an interest in field work in cold climates.

Subject description

Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterized by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks.

Project description

The Robotics and Artificial Intelligence (RAI) group belongs to the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering. The group took part in the DARPA Subterranean Challenge with the CoSTAR team led by NASA/JPL. Its applications include robotics for mining, aerial inspection of ageing infrastructure, autonomy for space robotics and multi-robot search and rescue. More information is available at https://www.ltu.se/robotics as well as http://www.fieldrobotics.eu

Drones make it possible to inspect infrastructure and terrain in the Arctic without sending people into dangerous conditions, but the cold affects the hardware the drones depend on. Batteries lose capacity, ice forms on lenses and propellers, and lidar and cameras return degraded data in blowing snow, fog and low sun. At high magnetic latitudes, magnetometers become unreliable for heading, and GNSS reception can be limited in fjords and steep terrain. This position will develop sensing and autonomy that work under these conditions, with drone inspection in environments such as Greenland as the main application.

The research will focus on one or more of the following areas.

    Design, characterisation and calibration of cold-hardened sensor payloads for drones, for example lidar, radar, thermal cameras, event cameras and inertial sensors
    Multi-sensor state estimation and mapping that accounts for degraded sensor data, for example in snow, fog, low-texture scenes and with unreliable GNSS or magnetometer data
    Sensor health monitoring and fault detection, so that the autonomy systems can detect when a sensor can no longer be trusted and adapt to it
    Energy- and weather-aware mission planning for inspection flights that accounts for battery behaviour in the cold and for wind
    Autonomous inspection of infrastructure and terrain in Arctic settings, with field experiments in cold climates, for example in Greenland and northern Sweden

Duties

The duties of a postdoctoral researcher are primarily research. The research has a substantial experimental part, with work on real drones and field experiments in cold climates that involve travel. You will publish the results in international peer-reviewed journals and at major conferences. The position also includes co-supervision of PhD and master's students and taking part in applications for research funding from funding agencies, the EU framework programme and industry. Teaching may be included for at most one fifth of working time.

Qualifications

To be eligible for employment as a postdoctoral researcher, you must hold a PhD or a foreign degree equivalent to a PhD in robotics, automatic control, computer science, electrical engineering or a related subject. It is a merit if the doctoral degree was awarded no more than three years before the application deadline. Candidates who were awarded their doctoral degree earlier may also be considered if there are special grounds, for example different types of statutory leave.

You need a good knowledge of state estimation, sensor fusion or robot perception, and documented experience of experimental work with drones. Previous work with experimentally verified results in at least one of the research areas above is required. You also need good programming skills in C++ and Python and experience of ROS or ROS 2. Good oral and written English is required, since you will present the group's work in Sweden and abroad.

Experience of sensor integration and drone hardware, of perception with lidar, radar or thermal cameras, of field experiments in cold or harsh environments, or of autonomous inspection missions is a merit.

Further information

This is a full-time, fixed-term position as a postdoctoral researcher for two years, with the possibility of extension to a maximum of three years in total. The position is based in Luleå. The starting date is by agreement.

For further information about the position, please contact

Chaired Professor George Nikolakopoulos, +46 920-49 1298, mailto:geonik@ltu.se

Postdoctoral Researcher, Akash Patel, mailto:akash.patel@ltu.se

For each position, a preliminary https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities and market conditions of the role.

https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Tradeunioncontacts

In case of different interpretations of the English and Swedish versions of this announcement, the Swedish version takes precedence.

Application

Also include a research plan of at most two pages that describes how you would approach one or more of the research areas above, and the names and contact details of two references. title: Security Coordinator
description:
DESCRIPTION

Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.

With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.

SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.

Do you enjoy helping people, keeping things organized and working in a role that combines administration with practical tasks?

Join SSC Space as a Security Coordinator at Esrange Space Center in Kiruna. You will help coordinate visits, guide visitors on site and keep security documentation in order, working closely with our Site Security Officer to ensure visits run smoothly and security routines are followed.

REQUIREMENTS

We are looking for someone who is organized, dependable and service-minded, with sound judgement and a practical approach to work. You are comfortable following established routines, handling confidential information and asking for guidance when something is unclear. A formal security background is not required.

To succeed in this role, you need:

    Experience in administration and confidence using common digital tools to maintain accurate records and documentation.
    The ability to communicate clearly and professionally in Swedish and English, both spoken and written.
    A valid category B driving license for driving within the EEA and a responsible approach to driving.
    The ability to stay calm, prioritize tasks and adapt when plans change.
    The confidence to uphold security routines, including pausing an activity and seeking guidance when requirements are unclear.

Experience in reception, logistics, transport, facility services or security support is an advantage, particularly if you have coordinated visitors, contractors or deliveries. First-aid or defensive-driving training is also welcome.

RESPONSIBILITIES

You will support the day-to-day work of the Security function, combining visitor coordination, administration and practical support.

Working within established instructions and approved access arrangements, you will:

    Prepare and coordinate visits by confirming required information, checking documentation and communicating practical instructions to visitors, contractors and suppliers.
    Support reception and access coordination in line with approved clearances and local security routines.
    Escort visitors within security-sensitive areas, explaining site rules and ensuring movement restrictions are followed.
    Provide safe and professional transport within the site, using authorized vehicles and approved routes.
    Maintain accurate registrations, records, checklists and security documentation.
    Support the Site Security Officer with practical preparations, information gathering and follow-up.
    Promptly report missing documentation, access concerns, incidents or unclear instructions, and contribute to improvements in daily routines.

BENEFITS

We offer you

    A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
    An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
    An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.

Additional benefits

    In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
    Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
    Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
    Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
    Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.



LOCATION

This is a full-time, permanent position based at our space base Esrange outside of Kiruna.

  

NEXT STEP

If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.

When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.

As part of our recruitment process, all candidates selected for employment undergo a background check and security screening. Citizenship requirements may apply depending on the role.



WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE

SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.

With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.

 We help Earth benefit from Space.

Learn more at sscspace.com

title: IT Manager - Konsultuppdrag i Göteborg
description:
About the Assignment

We are looking for an experienced IT Manager for an exciting consulting assignment with an international, technology-driven organization in Gothenburg.

In this role, you will take overall responsibility for the delivery, governance, security, and continuous development of the organization's IT environment. The position combines strategic planning and budgeting with hands-on operational responsibility, making it ideal for someone who enjoys working both strategically and close to the technology.

You will act as the primary point of contact between the business and external IT service providers, ensuring that IT solutions are secure, scalable, cost-effective, and aligned with business needs.

Core Areas of Ownership

• IT Budget & Financial Planning • IT Operations & End-User Support • IT Infrastructure & Networking • Microsoft Azure & Cloud Services • Endpoint Management (Intune, Apple Business Manager) • Hardware & Software Procurement • Lifecycle & Asset Management • Digital Signage Solutions • Teams Rooms & Video Conferencing Systems • Information Security & TISAX Compliance • IT Policies & Governance • Vendor & IT Partner Management • Workplace Technology & Office IT Equipment • Technology Strategy & Roadmap

Key Requirements

• Experience managing Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID, and Azure environments. • Good understanding of network infrastructure, including switching, routing, firewalls, VPNs, and wireless networking. • Experience in IT budgeting, procurement, and vendor management. • Knowledge of information security principles and compliance frameworks such as TISAX. • Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, network, and cloud environments. • Ability to work both strategically and operationally in a hands-on role. • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. • Experience coordinating external IT service providers and consultants. • Ability to translate business requirements into practical technology solutions. • Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken is required.  • Swedish language skills are considered a strong advantage.

About you

You are a proactive and business-oriented IT professional who enjoys taking ownership of the entire IT landscape. You are equally comfortable discussing long-term technology strategy with stakeholders as you are resolving operational challenges. With a hands-on approach and strong communication skills, you build trust across the organization and ensure that technology effectively supports business objectives.

Assignment Details

Role: IT Manager Location: Gothenburg, Sweden Assignment period: 12 October 2026 – 11 April 2027 Application deadline: 7 October 2026  Work Arrangement: Primarily on-site Seniority Level: Expert

title: Director of Lab Operations
description:
Single Cell Discoveries is seeking a Lab Operations Director to lead and oversee all laboratory operations at our Gothenburg laboratory, TATAA Biocenter! This is a senior leadership role for a hands-on operational leader who thrives on responsibility, solving complex challenges, and can make confident decisions in a fast-moving environment while maintaining the highest standards of regulatory compliance. You will be responsible for laboratory operations, facility management, and site-wide coordination. You will ensure the site runs smoothly, the infrastructure and processes needed for compliance are in place, and our scientists have everything they need to deliver exceptional results for sponsors around the world.

Are you energized by accountability, motivated by helping teams succeed, and eager to play a key role in a growing, accredited CRO? We would like to hear from you!

Who Are We?

TATAA Biocenter, part of the Single Cell Discoveries Group, is a specialized molecular analysis CRO supporting pharmaceutical and biotech sponsors worldwide. Our laboratory is GCLP-compliant and accredited under GLP and ISO 17025:2017, with deep expertise in qPCR, dPCR, RNA-seq/NGS, and biomarker analysis. We combine scientific excellence with a collaborative and entrepreneurial culture, helping sponsors accelerate innovations in precision medicine.As Lab Operations Director, you will work closely with laboratory teams, quality assurance, IT, business development, vendors, external partners, and company leadership to ensure the smooth and efficient operation of the entire site. You will report directly to the group COO.

What Will You Do?

    Lead and oversee operations of the Gothenburg laboratory site.
    Serve as a key point of escalation for laboratory staff, operational challenges, and project execution issues.
    Ensure laboratory infrastructure, equipment, and facilities are maintained and operate efficiently.
    Coordinate and manage relationships with vendors, service providers, contractors, engineers, and facility partners.
    Support laboratory teams in prioritization, problem-solving, and operational decision-making.
    Drive continuous improvement initiatives across laboratory operations, infrastructure, and processes.
    Partner with scientific and operational teams to support the successful execution of client projects.
    Support capacity planning, resource allocation, and operational growth initiatives.
    Provide strong site leadership, fostering a safe, compliant, and high-performing environment.
    Represent site operations internally and externally, including during client, vendor, and regulatory interactions.
    Have budget responsibility for all operations in our Gothenburg site.
    Design strategies that fit the group’s goals and present progress to our COO and CEO, as well as our board.

Who Are We Looking For?

Essential

    You hold a MSc or PhD in a relevant field, with significant industry experience (preferably within CRO or pharma bioanalytical setting).
    You are an engaging people leader who motivates colleagues through energy, trust, and collaboration.
    You have significant experience managing laboratory operations, preferably within a regulated environment.
    You have experience working within regulated laboratory environments, including GxP frameworks (e.g., GLP, GCLP) and/or accredited quality systems such as ISO 17025.
    You are comfortable taking ownership and making decisions, including under time pressure.
    You have a proven ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and priorities simultaneously.
    You are a natural problem-solver who enjoys helping others overcome operational challenges.
    You have experience working with external vendors, contractors, facility providers, and technical service partners.
    You possess excellent organizational and communication skills in English, both written and oral.

Preferred

    Experience acting as Test Site Manager, Deputy Test Site Manager, or in a similar regulated laboratory leadership role.
    Experience supporting inspections, audits, and accreditation activities.
    Experience in a CRO, biotech, pharmaceutical, or life sciences environment
    Experience presenting operational matters to senior leadership, company owners, or a board of directors.

Who You Are

    You enjoy responsibility and proactivity.
    You like making things happen.
    You are approachable, and people naturally come to you with questions and challenges.
    You can switch effortlessly between discussions with scientists, engineers, vendors, and leadership teams.
    You bring energy, pragmatism, and common sense.
    You are decisive, confident, and action oriented.
    Quality and accountability come naturally to you.

Why Join TATAA?

    A highly visible leadership role with significant influence on the future of the organization.
    Ownership of laboratory operations within a growing and internationally recognized CRO.
    The opportunity to work with talented scientists in a collaborative and entrepreneurial environment.
    A role where your decisions directly impact employees, sponsors, and business success.
    The chance to help shape the future of precision medicine and advanced molecular analysis.

Join us in accelerating innovations in precision medicine.  

Need more info? For questions about this opening or the recruitment process, please contact us at jobs@tataa.com.

Visit us at https://tataa.com/.

title: Country Medical Director 20%/ Medical Director 60% Järfälla
description:
PURPOSE OF THIS POSITION:

This is an 80% combined medical leadership and clinical role, allocated as 20% Country Medical Director and 60% Medical Director. The role provides country-level medical governance, quality oversight and regulatory assurance while retaining primary responsibility for direct nephrology and dialysis care, treatment decisions, patient follow-up and clinical delivery at clinic level.



KEY RESULT AREA AND RESPONSIBILITES:

Country Medical Director — 20% of the role

·        Provide country-level medical leadership and advise the Country Managing Director on medical quality, patient outcomes, clinical risk and regulatory matters.

·        Ensure national implementation of and compliance with Diaverum clinical policies, procedures and guidelines, together with applicable Swedish legal and regulatory requirements.

·        Review medical staff credentials and oversee medical practice to confirm that physicians are appropriately licensed, competent and authorized to work in dialysis services.

·        Ensure adequate physician coverage and medical continuity in accordance with regulatory and operational requirements.

·        Review country and clinic quality information, including patient outcomes, mortality, infection control, medical records, water quality, preventive maintenance and medical-equipment maintenance.

·        Serve as a member of the country management and quality-assurance forums as required, and lead follow-up of agreed medical improvement actions.

·        Act as the senior medical liaison with hospitals, healthcare providers and relevant external stakeholders regarding services delivered to Diaverum patients.

·        Escalate significant medical, clinical or operational risks and drive corrective actions and improvements across the country organization.

Medical Director — 60% of the role

·        The Medical Director is the head of the production of hemofiltration fluids within the dialysis department.He or she is ensuring that the production in the department is medically appropriate. Another task is to ensure the patients’ clinical and medical quality performance.

·        Maintain the licenses, authorizations and liability documentation required to practice medicine and fulfil Diaverum´s  internal medical requirements.

·        Lead the clinic's medical work and ensure safe, evidence-based and high-quality nephrology and dialysis care.



·        Take responsibility for diagnostic and therapeutic decisions for assigned patients, including dialysis prescription, dialysis-related conditions, vascular access, underlying kidney disease and treatment modality selection.

·        Provide individual physician consultations at least weekly, assess treatment progress at least monthly, and complete multidisciplinary treatment reviews at least every six months or more frequently when clinically required.

·        Manage referrals and medical communication with hospitals, specialist services and ambulatory care providers, including transplantation work-up and pre- and post-transplant dialysis.

·        Participate in therapeutic conferences and multidisciplinary activities covering vascular access, nutrition, social support, patient and family education and staff education.

·        Ensure timely, complete and accurate medical records and quality data, including required QI, QMR, HMR and quarterly reporting.

·        Ensure compliance with GDPR, public-health and epidemiological requirements, and implement measures to prevent infection and reduce hepatitis morbidity.

·        Oversee the medical suitability of hemofiltration-fluid production and the quality of water used for dialysis, including monitoring of cultures, endotoxins, disinfection, water-quality results and pyrogenic reactions.

·        Participate in clinic and country meetings as needed and contribute to internal medical education.

Allocation and coordination

The position totals 80% of full-time employment. The 20% Country Medical Director allocation is reserved for national medical governance and oversight; the 60% Medical Director allocation is reserved for clinic-level medical leadership and patient care. Priorities are coordinated with the Country Managing Director to protect both allocations and ensure continuity of care.



QUALIFICATIONS:

Education

University degree in Medical School

Experience

At least 10 years experience in renal services

Languages

Superior command of written and spoken English

IT

Good knowledge of MS Office applications and company medical software system





BEHAVIOUR AREAS:

Behaviors related to position

­ Ability to establish collaborative working relationships within all levels of the organization, as well as with external customers, service providers, payers, etc.

­ Demonstrates a positive, proactive approach to problem solving and impediments. Mentors and motivates others to understand this approach and to do the same.

­ Demonstrated effective ability to lead people and projects.

­ Demonstrated ability to utilize diplomacy and confidentiality when dealing with sensitive issues.

­ Requires strong analytical skills, ability to identify, define, and solve problems rapidly and to think and plan strategically.

­ Requires demonstrated expertise in planning, budgeting, and project management directed toward achievement of annual, long-term and strategic business plans and goals.

­ Demonstrated oral and written communication skills are required, as well as superior command of written and spoken English language.

­ Previous management experience in the specific functional area required.

­ Demonstrated ability to manage a corporate-wide function in multi-divisional environment, including problem resolution and consensus building between diverse management groups.
